# <foot-notes>

Progressive enhancement for footnotes: collects the <foot-note> elements that precede it into a labelled doc-endnotes list (or margin sidenotes), with doc-noteref references, doc-backlink return links, shared notes for repeat citations and a hover/focus preview.

- Web component. Needs the Vanilla Breeze script; its children are the fallback when script has not run.
- Documentation: https://vanilla-breeze.com/docs/elements/web-components/footnotes/
- Vanilla Breeze 0.7.4

## Example

```html
<p>
  The Vanilla Breeze framework<foot-note>Vanilla Breeze is an experimental
  component library.</foot-note> provides a layered approach.
</p>

<foot-notes></foot-notes>
```

## Attributes

| Attribute | Values | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `data-mode` | `sidenotes` |  | Omit for a collected notes list; "sidenotes" places each note in the margin beside its reference (notes with data-side="false" still go to the list). Observed: changing it re-renders. |
| `data-label-back` | string | `Back to content` | Accessible name of the backlinks; a note cited several times gets " (a)", " (b)" … appended. Observed at runtime. |
| `data-label-ref` | string | `Footnote {n}` | Accessible name of each reference link; {n} is replaced by the note number. Observed at runtime. |
| `data-label-heading` | string | `Notes` | Text of the generated, visually hidden heading that labels the doc-endnotes section. Ignored when the author supplies a heading child (h1–h6), which is used as the label instead. Observed at runtime. |
| `data-preview` | `false` |  | "false" disables the hover / keyboard-focus preview popover on references. Observed at runtime. |

## Attributes on children

| Attribute | On | Values | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `data-side` | foot-note | string |  | "false" opts a note out of sidenote placement in data-mode="sidenotes"; it is collected into the list instead. |
| `data-ref` | foot-note | string |  | Id of an earlier or later <foot-note> collected by the same <foot-notes>: this element becomes another citation of that note (no content of its own) and the note gets one backlink per citation (a, b, …). |

## Structure

| Child | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `<foot-note>` | Inline note anywhere BEFORE the <foot-notes> in document order (not necessarily a child). Phrasing content; without JS it renders in parentheses. Enhanced: its content nodes are moved (not copied) into the note, and it holds a superscript <a role="doc-noteref"> (id fnref-I-N, fnref-I-N-b for repeat citations). |
| `<h1>–<h6> (optional)` | A heading child of <foot-notes> labels the generated <section role="doc-endnotes">; otherwise a visually hidden <h2> with data-label-heading is generated. |

## Accessibility

- Pattern: Footnote links (DPUB-ARIA)
- The component manages: `role="doc-noteref"`, `role="doc-endnotes"`, `role="doc-backlink"`, `role="note"`, `aria-label`, `aria-labelledby`, `aria-hidden`, `inert`, `hidden`, `tabindex`

## Keyboard

| Keys | Action | When |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `Escape` | Hide the note preview popover | A preview is showing |

---

# <form-field>

Accessible form field: binds its control (native or form-associated custom element), times validation, shows hint/error outputs and wires aria-describedby / aria-invalid

- Web component. Needs the Vanilla Breeze script; its children are the fallback when script has not run.
- Documentation: https://vanilla-breeze.com/docs/elements/web-components/form-field/
- Vanilla Breeze 0.7.4

## Example

```html
<form-field>
  <label for="name">Full Name</label>
  <input type="text"
         id="name"
         name="name"
         required
         minlength="2"
         autocomplete="name"
         aria-describedby="name-hint name-error" />
  <output id="name-hint" class="hint" for="name">As it appears on your ID.</output>
  <output id="name-error" class="error" for="name" aria-live="polite">
    Please enter at least 2 characters.
  </output>
</form-field>
```

## Attributes

| Attribute | Values | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `data-valid` | boolean |  | Valid state. Set by the component when a valid field has a value (not for empty optional fields); can be set by hand. |
| `data-invalid` | boolean |  | Invalid state: reveals output.error and the error icon. Set by validate()/setError(); survives moving the field. |
| `data-type` | string |  | Inline label + control layout for checkable controls. No validation icon. |
| `data-no-icon` | boolean |  | Disable the validation status icons. |
| `data-floating-label` | boolean |  | Animated floating label (floating-label-init). A real placeholder keeps the label floated. Adds data-floating-label-ready when enhanced. |
| `data-pending` | boolean |  | Dims the field and blocks pointer input while something is in flight. |
| `data-state` | string |  | Async validation hook: warning border and spinner in the icon slot. |
| `data-message-invalid` | string | `Please check this field.` | Last-resort error message when no data-message-*, authored error text or control message applies. |
| `data-label-show-password` | string | `Show password` | Accessible name of the password toggle while the password is hidden. |
| `data-label-hide-password` | string | `Hide password` | Accessible name of the password toggle while the password is shown. |
| `data-label-digit` | string | `Digit {n} of {total}` | OTP/PIN box name; {n} and {total} are replaced. |
| `data-label-incomplete` | string | `Enter all {total} digits` | OTP/PIN partial-code message (used when the input has no data-message-patternmismatch); {total} is replaced. |
| `data-label-strength` | string | `Password strength` | Accessible name of the password strength meter. |
| `data-label-strength-weak` | string | `Weak` | Strength level text. |
| `data-label-strength-fair` | string | `Fair` | Strength level text. |
| `data-label-strength-good` | string | `Good` | Strength level text. |
| `data-label-strength-strong` | string | `Strong` | Strength level text. |
| `data-label-requirements` | string | `Password requirements` | Accessible name of the password rules checklist. |
| `data-label-rule-length` | string | `At least {n} characters` | Length rule text; {n} is replaced. |
| `data-label-rule-uppercase` | string | `One uppercase letter` | Uppercase rule text. |
| `data-label-rule-lowercase` | string | `One lowercase letter` | Lowercase rule text. |
| `data-label-rule-number` | string | `One number` | Number rule text. |
| `data-label-rule-special` | string | `One special character` | Special-character rule text. |
| `data-label-strength-empty` | string | `No password entered` | Meter value text (aria-valuetext) when the password is empty. |
| `data-label-strength-too-weak` | string | `Choose a stronger password. Meet more of the requirements.` | Validity message when the password is below data-strength-min. |
| `data-label-rule-met` | string | `met` | Visually hidden state text appended to a met rule. |
| `data-label-rule-unmet` | string | `not met` | Visually hidden state text appended to an unmet rule. |
| `data-floating-label-ready` | boolean |  | Set by floating-label-init once the floating label is wired. Do not set by hand. |
| `data-otp-ready` | boolean |  | Set once the OTP/PIN boxes are built (hides the status icon). Do not set by hand. |

## Attributes on children

| Attribute | On | Values | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `data-message-valuemissing` | input | string |  | Message for valueMissing. Every ValidityState key has one: data-message-badinput, -typemismatch, -patternmismatch, -tooshort, -toolong, -rangeunderflow, -rangeoverflow, -stepmismatch, -customerror. On a custom element (or the field) for custom controls. |
| `data-message-badinput` | input | string |  | Message when the browser can't parse the entry (e.g. letters in type=number). |
| `data-message-customerror` | input | string |  | Message for a custom validity error; without it the custom message itself is shown. |
| `data-type` | input | string |  | Multi-box OTP/PIN entry. The input stays a visually hidden, validatable text input (required + a \d{length} pattern). |
| `data-length` | input | number | `6` | Number of OTP/PIN digits. |
| `data-strength` | input | boolean |  | Password strength meter + rules checklist. |
| `data-rules` | input | string | `length:8` | Comma-separated strength rules: length:N, uppercase, lowercase, number, special. Unicode-aware; unknown rules are skipped with a warning. |
| `data-strength-min` | input | string |  | Minimum strength level; weaker non-empty passwords get a custom validity error. Advisory when absent. |
| `data-count` | textarea | string |  | Character ("") or word ("words") counter, added to aria-describedby; announced only near the limit. |
| `class` | output | string |  | hint: help text, collapses when valid; error: hidden (visibility: hidden) until invalid, authored text is the fallback message. |

## Structure

| Child | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `<label>` | Field label (for= the control id). The required asterisk goes on it when it is the field's only label. |
| `<input> \| <textarea> \| <select> \| form-associated custom element` | The bound control. Radios bind their whole name group. |
| `<output class="hint">` | Help text; listed in aria-describedby. |
| `<output class="error">` | Error message; in aria-describedby only while invalid. |

## Events

| Event | Detail | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `form-field:upgraded` |  | Bubbles once the field has bound its control. |

## Methods

| Method | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `validate({ show = true } = {})` | Validate the bound control and show the result immediately (error text, data-invalid/data-valid, aria-invalid, aria-describedby) — no blur needed; the form coordinator calls it on submit. Returns the validity. { show: false } returns validity without touching the UI. |
| `setError(message)` | Show a programmatic (e.g. server) error. Also set as the native control's custom validity so the form won't submit; cleared on the user's next edit. Never clears a custom error set by other code. |
| `clearError()` | Clear the field's own programmatic error and return to the neutral state. |

## Properties

| Property | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `fieldName` | `string` | Human-readable field name (label or legend text, else aria-label, name or id) for error summaries. Read-only. |
| `input` | `HTMLElement \| null` | The bound control: the first form-associated custom element in the field (date-picker, star-rating, combo-box …), else the first native input/textarea/select. Read-only. |

## Accessibility

- Pattern: Native form controls
- You provide: A <label for> for the control, plus <output class="hint"> and <output class="error" aria-live="polite"> elements for the messages
- The component manages: `aria-describedby`, `aria-invalid`

---

# <geo-map>

A zero-dependency map component using OpenStreetMap / CARTO raster tiles or your own tile proxy, with a lazy-loaded interactive pan / zoom mode.

- Web component. Needs the Vanilla Breeze script; its children are the fallback when script has not run.
- Documentation: https://vanilla-breeze.com/docs/elements/web-components/geo-map/
- Vanilla Breeze 0.7.4

## Example

```html
<geo-map lat="40.7484" lng="-73.9857" zoom="15">
  <address>
    <strong>Empire State Building</strong><br/>
    20 W 34th St, New York, NY 10001
  </address>
</geo-map>
```

## Attributes

| Attribute | Values | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `lat` | number |  | Latitude of the map centre. With lng, highest-priority coordinate source. |
| `lng` | number |  | Longitude of the map centre. |
| `zoom` | number | `15` | Tile zoom level 1–19; out-of-range values fall back to 15. |
| `marker` | (no value), `true`, `false` | `true` | Show the pin at the centre (bare or "true"); "false" hides it. |
| `marker-color` | string |  | Pin fill, any CSS colour. Invalid values are ignored (the pin falls back to --geo-map-marker-color, then --color-error). |
| `provider` | `osm`, `carto-light`, `carto-dark`, `carto-auto` | `osm` | Built-in tile source. carto-auto picks carto-dark or carto-light from the nearest data-mode (else prefers-color-scheme) and follows changes. Each provider shows its required credit. |
| `tile-url` | string |  | Tile URL template overriding provider: {z} {x} {y}, {s} (a/b/c subdomain rotation) and {r} ("@2x" on high-density screens). Set attribution for the credit. See /docs/extensibility/service-facade/. |
| `attribution` | string |  | Credit text shown for a tile-url source (built-in providers always show their own). A child with slot="attribution" replaces it. |
| `attribution-href` | string |  | Link for the attribution credit (http/https only). |
| `interactive` | `click`, `eager`, `none` | `click` | click: the map surface is an activation button; eager: interactive on load (without moving focus); none: static view only. |
| `static-only` | boolean |  | Never activate (same as interactive="none"). |
| `loading` | `lazy`, `eager`, `consent` | `lazy` | Tile loading. consent: request nothing from the tile host until the user presses "Load map" (shows a placeholder naming the host; the slotted address stays visible). |
| `label` | string |  | Accessible name of the map. Default: "Map of …" from the slotted <address> text, the src address / JSON-LD name, or place; else "Map". |
| `src` | string |  | ID of an <address data-lat data-lng> or a <script type="application/ld+json"> with geo.latitude / geo.longitude to read coordinates (and the name) from. |
| `place` | string |  | Name matched against JSON-LD scripts on the page (data.name); the match's geo supplies coordinates. |
| `data-ready` | boolean |  | Set when the static tiles have finished loading (with geo-map:ready); removed on each re-render. |
| `data-label-map` | string | `Map` | Accessible name when nothing names the place. |
| `data-label-map-of` | string | `Map of {name}` | Accessible name template; {name} is the address text, src name or place. |
| `data-label-activate` | string | `Activate interactive map` | Visible text (and name) of the activation button. |
| `data-label-consent` | string | `Load map` | Consent button text (loading="consent"). |
| `data-label-consent-note` | string | `Loads map images from {host}` | Consent note; {host} is the tile host. |
| `data-label-zoom-in` | string | `Zoom in` | Zoom-in button name. |
| `data-label-zoom-out` | string | `Zoom out` | Zoom-out button name. |
| `data-label-recenter` | string | `Recenter map` | Recenter button name. |
| `data-label-exit` | string | `Exit map` | Exit button name (returns to the static view). |
| `data-label-controls` | string | `Map controls` | Name of the control button group. |
| `data-label-instructions` | string |  | Key / gesture instructions referenced by aria-describedby in interactive mode. |
| `data-label-moved` | string | `Map centred on {lat}, {lng}, zoom {zoom}` | Polite live-region announcement after pan / zoom. |
| `data-label-error-coords` | string | `Map location unavailable` | On-screen text when no coordinates resolve. |
| `data-label-error-tiles` | string | `Map images failed to load` | On-screen text when every tile fails. |

## Attributes on children

| Attribute | On | Values | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `data-lat` | address | number |  | Latitude on a slotted (or src-referenced) <address>. |
| `data-lng` | address | number |  | Longitude on a slotted (or src-referenced) <address>. |
| `slot` | * | `attribution` |  | slot="attribution" replaces the credit line. |

## Events

| Event | Detail | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `geo-map:ready` | `{ lat, lng, zoom }` | Static tiles finished loading (data-ready is set). |
| `geo-map:activate` | `{ lat, lng, zoom }` | Interactive mode started. |
| `geo-map:move` | `{ lat, lng, zoom }` | After a pan or zoom in interactive mode (new centre, 6 decimal places). |
| `geo-map:data-changed` | `{ data, source: 'property' }` | After a .data assignment that changed something. |
| `geo-map:error` | `{ message }` | No coordinates resolved, or every tile failed to load. |

## Properties

| Property | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `data` | `{ lat?: number, lng?: number, zoom: number, marker: boolean, markerColor: string }` | Get the map state, or assign a partial object: attributes are written as one batch and the map re-renders once. Assigning the current state is a no-op; an invalid markerColor is ignored, '' clears it. Emits geo-map:data-changed. |
| `markers` | `Array<{ lat: number, lng: number, color: string }>` | The centre marker as a one-element array when coordinates resolve, else []. |
| `active` | `boolean` | True while interactive mode is on (also the :state(active) custom state). |

## Accessibility

- Pattern: Image, then an application-like region once activated
- You provide: A place name (label attribute or caption content) so the map image has a meaningful name
- The component manages: `role="img"`, `role="region"`, `role="group"`, `role="status"`, `aria-label`, `aria-roledescription`, `aria-describedby`, `aria-hidden`, `aria-live`, `tabindex`, `hidden`

## Keyboard

| Keys | Action | When |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `Enter` / `Space` | Switch the static map to interactive mode and focus the map | Native behaviour of button (the activate button) |
| `ArrowLeft` / `ArrowRight` / `ArrowUp` / `ArrowDown` | Pan the map | Focus on the interactive map |
| `+` / `=` | Zoom in | Focus on the interactive map |
| `-` / `_` | Zoom out | Focus on the interactive map |
| `Home` / `0` | Return to the original centre | Focus on the interactive map |
| `Escape` | Leave interactive mode and return focus to the activate button | Focus on the interactive map |

# <glossary-index>

Interactive glossary with search filtering and scroll-spy letter tracking; copyable term permalinks are opt-in

- Web component. Needs the Vanilla Breeze script; its children are the fallback when script has not run.
- Documentation: https://vanilla-breeze.com/docs/elements/web-components/glossary-index/
- Vanilla Breeze 0.7.4

## Example

```html
<glossary-index>
  <nav class="glossary-jump" aria-label="Jump to letter">
    <a href="#A">A</a>
    <a href="#B">B</a>
    <a href="#C">C</a>
  </nav>

  <section class="glossary-section" id="A">
    <h2>A</h2>
    <dl>
      <dt><dfn>Accessibility</dfn></dt>
      <dd>The practice of making websites usable by everyone.</dd>

      <dt><dfn>ARIA</dfn></dt>
      <dd>Accessible Rich Internet Applications specification.</dd>
    </dl>
  </section>

  <section class="glossary-section" id="B">
    <h2>B</h2>
    <dl>
      <dt><dfn>Breadcrumb</dfn></dt>
      <dd>A navigation pattern showing the user's location.</dd>
    </dl>
  </section>
</glossary-index>
```

## Attributes

| Attribute | Values | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `placeholder` | string | `Filter terms…` | Placeholder text for the injected search input (a hint, not its label — see data-label-filter) |
| `permalinks` | boolean |  | Add a copy-link # beside each term that has an id. Off by default: a glossary is mostly linked to, from terms in prose |
| `data-label-filter` | string | `Filter glossary terms` | Accessible name of the search input |
| `data-label-matches-one` | string | `{count} term matches` | Polite match-count announcement for the Intl.PluralRules "one" category ({count} is replaced). Any category works: -few, -many, -zero, -two. |
| `data-label-matches-other` | string | `{count} terms match` | Match-count announcement for the "other" category and the fallback for unset categories |
| `data-label-all-one` | string | `Showing {count} term` | Announcement when the filter is cleared ("one" category) |
| `data-label-all-other` | string | `Showing all {count} terms` | Announcement when the filter is cleared ("other" category and fallback) |
| `data-label-empty` | string | `No terms match your filter.` | Visible empty-state message when nothing matches |
| `data-label-permalink` | string | `Copy link to` | Permalink name prefix; the term text is appended |
| `data-label-copied` | string | `Link copied to clipboard` | Screen-reader announcement after a permalink copies the term URL |

## Attributes on children

| Attribute | On | Values | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | dt | string |  | Term anchor: the target of links from prose and related terms (highlighted on arrival). With permalinks, each dt with an id also gets a # link that follows the fragment and copies the term URL. |

## Structure

| Child | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `nav.glossary-jump` | Letter jump navigation; its fragment links get aria-current="true" for the section in view and aria-disabled while their section is filtered out |
| `section.glossary-section` | One per letter group, with an id the jump links target (section[id^="glossary-"] also matches) |
| `dl` | Terms inside each section: dt/dd groups (several dt per dd, several dd per dt, or div-wrapped groups) |
| `dfn` | The defined term inside dt; used as the filter target when present (otherwise the dt text) |

## Events

| Event | Detail | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `glossary-index:filter` | `{ query, matchCount }` | After the filter is applied |

## Accessibility

- Pattern: Landmark navigation
- You provide: A <nav class="glossary-jump"> with an aria-label, and letter sections with ids and headings
- The component manages: `aria-current`, `aria-disabled`, `aria-label`, `aria-hidden`, `role="status"`, `aria-live`, `aria-atomic`, `hidden`, `tabindex`

# <glossary-wc>

Searchable, categorized, cross-linked glossary that progressively enhances a definition list

- Web component. Needs the Vanilla Breeze script; its children are the fallback when script has not run.
- Documentation: https://vanilla-breeze.com/docs/elements/web-components/glossary-wc/
- Vanilla Breeze 0.7.4

## Example

```html
<glossary-wc data-title="Project Glossary" searchable>
  <dl>
    <div data-category="Domain" data-term-id="velocity">
      <dt>Velocity</dt>
      <dd>The amount of work a team can complete in a sprint,
        measured in story points.</dd>
    </div>
    <div data-category="Domain" data-term-id="epic">
      <dt>Epic</dt>
      <dd>A large body of work broken down into stories.
        See also: <a href="#velocity">velocity</a>.</dd>
    </div>
    <div data-category="Technical" data-term-id="api-gateway">
      <dt>API Gateway</dt>
      <dd>Single entry point for all client requests.</dd>
    </div>
  </dl>
</glossary-wc>
```

## Attributes

| Attribute | Values | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `data-title` | string |  | Glossary heading, rendered as a real heading (the title attribute is not used). Observed. |
| `data-heading-level` | number | `2` | Heading level (1-6) for data-title. Observed. |
| `src` | string |  | URL to JSON term data: { title?, terms: [{ id, term, definition, category?, seeAlso?, definitionHtml? }] }. Fetched once per URL; an inline <dl> renders as the fallback while loading and if the fetch fails. Observed. |
| `searchable` | boolean |  | Adds a search input (inside a <search> landmark) that filters terms by name and definition. Observed. |
| `compact` | boolean |  | Reduced spacing variant. CSS only. |
| `data-state` | `loading`, `ready`, `error` |  | Set in src mode: loading while fetching, ready after the data renders, error when the fetch fails (an error message is shown and the fallback <dl> is kept). |
| `data-label-search` | string | `Search glossary terms` | Accessible name of the search input. |
| `data-label-search-placeholder` | string | `Search terms…` | Search input placeholder. |
| `data-label-terms` | string | `Glossary terms` | Accessible name of the terms region. |
| `data-label-alphabet` | string | `Alphabet navigation` | Accessible name of the jump-bar nav. |
| `data-label-found-one` | string | `{count} term found` | Search announcement for the Intl.PluralRules "one" category ({count} is replaced). Any category works: data-label-found-few, -many, -zero, -two. |
| `data-label-found-other` | string | `{count} terms found` | Search announcement for the "other" category and the fallback for unset categories. |
| `data-label-all-one` | string | `Showing {count} term` | Announcement when the search is cleared ("one" category; other categories as for found). |
| `data-label-all-other` | string | `Showing all {count} terms` | Announcement when the search is cleared ("other" category and fallback). |
| `data-label-uncategorized` | string | `Uncategorized` | Category label for terms without data-category. |
| `data-label-see-also` | string | `See also:` | Prefix for seeAlso links generated from JSON / .terms data. |
| `data-label-error` | string | `Could not load the glossary terms.` | Message shown when src fails to load. |

## Attributes on children

| Attribute | On | Values | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `data-category` | div | string |  | Category label for grouping terms |
| `data-term-id` | div | string |  | Unique term identifier, set as the div's id (fragment anchor). Jump-bar letters link to the first term of each letter. |

## Structure

| Child | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `dl` | Source definition list (optional with src: rendered as the fallback). Kept in place, hidden, while upgraded; restored on teardown. |
| `div[data-term-id]` | One per term inside the dl, wrapping its dt and dd |

## Events

| Event | Detail | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `glossary-wc:ready` | `{ termCount, categories }` | After every render (upgrade, reconnect, observed attribute change, .terms assignment, src load). Not fired while src is loading. |
| `glossary-wc:search` | `{ query, matchCount }` | After the (debounced) search input is applied |
| `glossary-wc:terms-changed` | `{ terms, source: 'property' }` | After .terms assignment (fires after the render's ready) |
| `glossary-wc:error` | `{ url, error }` | When src fails to load (HTTP error, invalid JSON, or no terms array) |

## Properties

| Property | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `terms` | `Array<{ id, term, definition, category?, seeAlso?, definitionHtml? }>` | Get the parsed terms ({ id, term, definition, category, seeAlso? }; definition is text), or assign to rebuild. Assigned entries are written into the source <dl>, so they survive moves and re-renders. definition is rendered as text; definitionHtml is an explicit opt-in passed through VB's HTML sanitizer. |

## Accessibility

- Pattern: Disclosure
- You provide: A <dl> of terms (or a src) with text in every <dt>
- The component manages: `role="region"`, `role="status"`, `role="alert"`, `role="link"`, `aria-label`, `aria-controls`, `aria-expanded`, `aria-disabled`, `aria-hidden`, `aria-live`, `aria-atomic`, `hidden`, `tabindex`

## Keyboard

| Keys | Action | When |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `Enter` / `Space` | Expand or collapse a category | Native behaviour of button (the category toggle) |

# <heading-links>

Add permalink anchors to headings; activating one follows the fragment and copies the section URL

- Web component. Needs the Vanilla Breeze script; its children are the fallback when script has not run.
- Documentation: https://vanilla-breeze.com/docs/elements/web-components/heading-links/
- Vanilla Breeze 0.7.4

## Example

```html
<heading-links>
  <h2>Getting Started</h2>
  <p>Content here...</p>
  <h3>Installation</h3>
  <p>More content...</p>
</heading-links>
```

## Attributes

| Attribute | Values | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `levels` | string | `h2,h3` | Comma-separated heading levels to process, h1–h6 only (default: 'h2,h3'). Invalid tokens are ignored; changes are observed |
| `data-label-anchor` | string | `Copy link to` | Anchor accessible-name prefix; the anchor is named "<prefix> <heading text>" (default: 'Copy link to'). Observed |
| `data-label-copied` | string | `Link copied to clipboard` | Screen-reader announcement after the URL is copied (default: 'Link copied to clipboard') |

## Attributes on children

| Attribute | On | Values | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `data-toc-ignore` | * | boolean |  | Skip this heading (or every heading inside this element): no anchor, no generated id. Shared with page-toc |

## Events

| Event | Detail | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `heading-links:navigate` | `{ id: string, url: string, heading: HTMLElement }` | Fires when an anchor is activated (unmodified primary click or Enter), after the fragment navigation and before the clipboard write |

## Accessibility

- Pattern: Link
- You provide: Headings with text content inside the element
- The component manages: `aria-label`, `aria-labelledby`, `tabindex`

# <highlight-wc>

Text highlighting with localStorage persistence. Inside <selection-menu> it renders a highlighter button + colour palette for the selection; standalone it renders no UI and exposes a JS API and events

- Web component. Needs the Vanilla Breeze script; its children are the fallback when script has not run.
- Documentation: https://vanilla-breeze.com/docs/elements/web-components/highlight-wc/
- Vanilla Breeze 0.7.4

## Example

```html
<article id="post">
  <h2>My Article</h2>
  <p>Select any text to highlight it.</p>
</article>

<selection-menu for="post">
  <highlight-wc></highlight-wc>
  <note-wc></note-wc>
</selection-menu>
```

## Attributes

| Attribute | Values | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `for` | string |  | Standalone mode: ID of the element to annotate (defaults to the first child element). Ignored inside <selection-menu>, which highlights its own targets |
| `colors` | string | `yellow,green,blue,pink` | Comma-separated palette colour names; each needs a --highlight-{name} token |
| `readonly` | boolean |  | Render stored highlights but disable creating new ones. Inside <selection-menu> no highlighter button is rendered |
| `storage-key` | string |  | Custom storage key suffix (default: page pathname) |
| `data-label-button` | string | `Highlight selection` | Accessible name of the highlighter button (selection-menu mode) |
| `data-label-palette` | string | `Highlight color` | Accessible name of the colour palette group (selection-menu mode) |
| `data-label-annotation` | string | `You highlighted` | Margin annotation text; forwarded to the target as data-highlights-label-annotation |
| `data-label-added` | string | `Highlight added` | Screen-reader announcement when a highlight is created; forwarded as data-highlights-label-added |
| `data-label-removed` | string | `Highlight removed` | Screen-reader announcement when a highlight is removed; forwarded as data-highlights-label-removed |

## Structure

| Child | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `<article>` | Standalone mode: content to annotate (when not using for=) |

## Events

| Event | Detail | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `highlights:added` | `{ id, text, color, note }` | A highlight was created. Dispatched on the target element and bubbles |
| `highlights:removed` | `{ id }` | A highlight was removed via removeHighlight(). Dispatched on the target and bubbles |
| `highlights:unplaced` | `{ highlights }` | Stored highlights were loaded and the text of one or more is no longer in the target. They stay in storage and are tried again on the next load. Dispatched on the target and bubbles |
| `highlights:selected` | `{ text, rect }` | Text was selected inside an interactive target — hook for a custom UI in standalone mode. Dispatched on the target and bubbles |
| `highlights:clicked` | `{ id, highlight }` | An existing highlight or its margin annotation was clicked. Dispatched on the target and bubbles |
| `highlights:note-changed` | `{ id, note }` | A note was saved (via <note-wc>). Dispatched on the target and bubbles |

## Methods

| Method | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `highlightSelection(color?)` | Highlight the current text selection in the given palette colour (default: last used). No-op when readonly or the colour is not in the palette |
| `getHighlights()` | Array of { id, startOffset, endOffset, text, prefix, suffix, color, note, created } records. Inside <selection-menu> the methods act on the most recently highlighted target (initially the first) |
| `removeHighlight(id)` | Remove one highlight by id |
| `clearAll()` | Remove every highlight on the target |
| `exportHighlights()` | JSON string { version: 1, highlights: [...] } |
| `importHighlights(json)` | Replace the highlights from an exported string or object. Records with a bad shape, offsets outside the text or a colour not in the palette are dropped. Returns { imported, rejected } |

## CSS custom properties

| Property | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `--highlight-yellow` | Yellow highlight wash (light-dark() pair) |
| `--highlight-green` | Green highlight wash (light-dark() pair) |
| `--highlight-blue` | Blue highlight wash (light-dark() pair) |
| `--highlight-pink` | Pink highlight wash (light-dark() pair) |
| `--highlight-ink` | Text colour of highlighted text (light-dark() pair); per-colour override --highlight-{name}-ink |

## Accessibility

- Pattern: Disclosure
- The component manages: `aria-expanded`, `aria-controls`, `aria-pressed`, `aria-label`, `aria-hidden`, `role="group"`, `hidden`

## Keyboard

| Keys | Action | When |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `Enter` / `Space` | Open the colour palette and focus the current colour | Native behaviour of button (the highlighter button) |
| `Escape` | Close the colour palette and return focus to the highlighter button | The palette is open |

# <icon-wc>

Inline SVG icon: fetches one sanitized SVG file per icon from <base-path>/<set>/<name>.svg, sized by preset and labelled for assistive tech

- Web component. Needs the Vanilla Breeze script; its children are the fallback when script has not run.
- Documentation: https://vanilla-breeze.com/docs/elements/web-components/icons/
- Vanilla Breeze 0.7.4

## Example

```html
<icon-wc name="home"></icon-wc>
<icon-wc name="settings"></icon-wc>
<icon-wc name="user"></icon-wc>
<icon-wc name="search"></icon-wc>
<icon-wc name="mail"></icon-wc>
```

## Attributes

| Attribute | Values | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `name` | string |  | Icon name (required): the SVG filename without .svg |
| `set` | string |  | Icon set directory (lucide, phosphor, tabler, mage, bold, custom). Defaults to the nearest data-icon-set on the element, an ancestor or <html>, then lucide. Icons missing from the set fall back to Lucide. |
| `size` | `xs`, `sm`, `md`, `lg`, `xl`, `2xl` | `md` | Size preset relative to the font size: 1em, 1.25em, 1.5em, 2em, 2.5em, 3em |
| `label` | string |  | Accessible name for a meaningful icon (role="img"). Without it the icon is decorative (aria-hidden). Adding or removing it updates the icon live. |
| `base-path` | string |  | Icon base URL for this icon. Defaults to <html data-icon-path>, then the icons/ folder beside the Vanilla Breeze bundle the page loaded (so a CDN or subpath install needs no setting), then /cdn/icons. |
| `data-flip-rtl` | boolean |  | Mirror the glyph horizontally when the icon is in a right-to-left context (directional icons such as arrows and chevrons) |
| `data-animate` | `spin` |  | Spins the icon while an ancestor has [data-loading] (disabled under prefers-reduced-motion) |
| `data-error` | boolean |  | Present when the icon could not be loaded from the requested set or the Lucide fallback; light-DOM content is shown instead |
| `data-upgraded` | boolean |  | Present while the element is connected and upgraded |

## Structure

| Child | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `light-DOM content` | Optional fallback shown until the SVG loads and when it fails (data-error) |

## Properties

| Property | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `name` | `string` | The name attribute |
| `set` | `string` | Resolved set: set attribute, else nearest data-icon-set, else lucide |
| `size` | `string` | The size attribute (default md) |
| `label` | `string \| null` | The label attribute |
| `basePath` | `string` | Resolved base URL: base-path attribute, else <html data-icon-path>, else /cdn/icons |
| `iconPath` | `string` | URL of the requested icon file (before any Lucide fallback) |

## Accessibility

- Pattern: Image
- You provide: A label attribute when the icon conveys meaning on its own; without it the icon is hidden from assistive technology
- The component manages: `role="img"`, `aria-label`, `aria-hidden`

---

# <image-gallery>

Thumbnail grid with lightbox viewer. Progressive enhancement: thumbnails link to full images without JS. With JS, opens a native <dialog> lightbox with prev/next, keyboard (direction-aware), swipe, and View Transitions.

- Web component. Needs the Vanilla Breeze script; its children are the fallback when script has not run.
- Documentation: https://vanilla-breeze.com/docs/elements/web-components/image-gallery/
- Vanilla Breeze 0.7.4

## Example

```html
<image-gallery>
  <a href="photos/full-1.jpg">
    <img src="photos/thumb-1.jpg" alt="Mountain landscape" loading="lazy" />
  </a>
  <a href="photos/full-2.jpg">
    <img src="photos/thumb-2.jpg" alt="Ocean sunset" loading="lazy" />
  </a>
</image-gallery>
```

## Attributes

| Attribute | Values | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `columns` | `100px`, `150px`, `200px`, `250px`, `300px` | `200px` | Minimum column width for the thumbnail grid. |
| `gap` | `none`, `xs`, `s`, `m`, `l`, `xl` | `s` | Gap between thumbnails. |
| `ratio` | `1`, `4:3`, `3:2`, `16:9`, `3:4`, `auto` | `1` | Aspect ratio for thumbnail images. |
| `controls` | `edge`, `bar`, `minimal` | `edge` | Lightbox control layout. 'edge' puts prev/next on the sides with a floating header, 'bar' moves prev/next into the top bar, 'minimal' shows close only (swipe/keyboard to navigate). Changing it rebuilds the lightbox on next open. |
| `loop` | boolean |  | Wrap navigation at first/last image. |
| `captions` | `auto`, `overlay`, `hidden` | `auto` | Caption display in the lightbox. 'auto' adds an info button in a footer that toggles the caption text (hidden attribute), 'overlay' shows the caption under the image, 'hidden' suppresses it. Changing it rebuilds the lightbox on next open. |
| `transition` | `morph`, `fade`, `none` | `morph` | View Transition type. 'morph' animates thumbnail to full image, 'fade' cross-fades, 'none' disables. |
| `data-label-dialog` | string | `Image viewer` | Accessible name of the lightbox dialog. |
| `data-label-close` | string | `Close gallery` | Close button name. |
| `data-label-prev` | string | `Previous image` | Previous button name. |
| `data-label-next` | string | `Next image` | Next button name. |
| `data-label-show-details` | string | `Show image details` | Info button name while the caption is collapsed (captions="auto"). |
| `data-label-hide-details` | string | `Hide image details` | Info button name while the caption is expanded (captions="auto"). |
| `data-label-counter` | string | `Image {n} of {total}` | Counter text template; {n} and {total} are replaced. Announced on navigation when the image has no alt text. |
| `data-label-announce` | string | `{alt}, {n} of {total}` | Text announced politely when the lightbox image changes; {alt}, {n} and {total} are replaced. |

## Structure

| Child | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `<a href="full.jpg">` | Image-only item: anchor wrapping a thumbnail img. |
| `<figure>` | Rich item: figure wrapping an anchor and figcaption. |
| `<img>` | Thumbnail image inside anchor. src is the thumbnail, parent anchor href is the full image. |
| `<figcaption>` | Optional caption inside figure. Supports HTML including links; its nodes are cloned into the lightbox. |

## Events

| Event | Detail | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `image-gallery:images-changed` | `{ images, source: 'property' }` | Fired after the images setter rebuilds the gallery. |

## Methods

| Method | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `open(index)` | Open the lightbox at a zero-based index (no-op when out of range). |
| `close()` | Close the lightbox (with the morph transition when enabled). |
| `next()` | Show the next image (wraps with loop). |
| `prev()` | Show the previous image (wraps with loop). |

## Properties

| Property | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `images` | `Array<{ href, thumbSrc, alt?, caption? }>` | Get the image set (caption is a string for text-only captions, a cloned DocumentFragment for markup, or null) or assign one to rebuild the thumbnails. String captions render as text, never HTML; pass a Node, DocumentFragment or <template> for rich captions. Assigning closes an open lightbox and fires image-gallery:images-changed with source 'property'. |

## Accessibility

- Pattern: Native dialog
- You provide: Thumbnail links that each contain an <img> with alt text
- The component manages: `aria-label`, `aria-expanded`, `aria-controls`, `hidden`

## Keyboard

| Keys | Action | When |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `Enter` | Open the lightbox at that image | Native behaviour of a (a thumbnail link) |
| `ArrowRight` | Show the next image (reversed in right-to-left) | Lightbox open |
| `ArrowLeft` | Show the previous image (reversed in right-to-left) | Lightbox open |
| `Home` | Show the first image | Lightbox open |
| `End` | Show the last image | Lightbox open |
| `Escape` | Close the lightbox | Native behaviour of dialog |

---

# <image-map>

Responsive image map: <map-area> children define percentage-coordinate hotspots (rect, circle, poly) over a child <img>, with an SVG hit-testing overlay, keyboard-focusable anchors, and rich HTML tooltips. Without JS the image renders and each map-area shows as a labeled list item.

- Web component. Needs the Vanilla Breeze script; its children are the fallback when script has not run.
- Documentation: https://vanilla-breeze.com/docs/elements/web-components/image-map/
- Vanilla Breeze 0.7.4

## Example

```html
<image-map>
  <img src="/maps/floor-plan.svg" alt="Office floor plan" />

  <map-area shape="rect" coords="5 8 40 44"
    label="Conference Hall" href="/rooms/conference">
    <p>Seats 120 people. AV equipment available.</p>
  </map-area>

  <map-area shape="circle" coords="62.5 32 10"
    label="Server Room" href="/rooms/server">
    <p>24 racks, climate controlled.</p>
  </map-area>

  <map-area shape="rect" coords="60 56 95 92"
    label="Open Office" href="/rooms/office">
    <p>80 hot-desk workstations.</p>
  </map-area>
</image-map>
```

## Attributes

| Attribute | Values | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `src` | string |  | Image URL used to create the <img> when no child <img> is authored. |
| `alt` | string |  | Alt text for the generated <img>. |
| `data-label-map` | string | `Image map` | Group name fallback when there is no aria-label/aria-labelledby and the image has no alt. |

## Attributes on children

| Attribute | On | Values | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `shape` | map-area | `rect`, `circle`, `poly` |  | Hotspot shape (default rect). |
| `coords` | map-area | string |  | Percentage coordinates (0-100), space or comma separated: rect x1 y1 x2 y2, circle cx cy r, poly x1 y1 x2 y2 ... |
| `label` | map-area | string |  | Accessible name of the hotspot; falls back to the area's text content. Shown as the list label without JS. |
| `href` | map-area | string |  | Navigation target; the hotspot becomes an <a> focus anchor. Not a link without JS: also author an <a href> in the content for no-JS reachability. |
| `target` | map-area | string |  | Link target for href (e.g. _blank). |
| `tooltip` | map-area | `hover`, `click`, `none` |  | Tooltip mode: hover (default; on hover/focus, hoverable), click (toggle on click/Enter/Space, focus moves into interactive content, Escape returns), none. |
| `disabled` | map-area | boolean |  | Removes the hotspot from interaction and the tab order. |

## Structure

| Child | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `<img>` | Direct child image the overlay is laid over (or use src/alt on the host). |
| `<map-area>` | Hotspot definition; its child content becomes the tooltip (and the no-JS list item body). |

## Events

| Event | Detail | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `image-map:area-enter` | `{ area }` | Pointer entered or focus moved onto an area; area is the <map-area> element. |
| `image-map:area-leave` | `{ area }` | Pointer left or focus moved off an area. |
| `image-map:area-activate` | `{ area }` | Area clicked, tapped, or activated with Enter/Space. Cancelable: preventDefault() stops link navigation. |
| `image-map:regions-changed` | `{ regions, source: 'property' }` | Fired after the regions setter rebuilds the map. |

## Properties

| Property | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `regions` | `Array<{ shape, coords, label?, href?, target?, tooltip?, disabled?, content? }>` | Get the regions from the <map-area> children (content is a string for text-only areas or a cloned DocumentFragment for markup) or assign to rebuild them. String content renders as text, never HTML; pass a Node, DocumentFragment or <template> for rich tooltips. Fires image-map:regions-changed with source 'property'. |

## Accessibility

- Pattern: Group of links and buttons with tooltips
- You provide: An <img> with alt text (used as the group name) and a label or text content on each <map-area>
- The component manages: `role="group"`, `role="tooltip"`, `aria-label`, `aria-describedby`, `aria-expanded`, `aria-controls`, `aria-disabled`, `aria-hidden`, `tabindex`, `hidden`

## Keyboard

| Keys | Action | When |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `Tab` | Move to the next hotspot in source order; every hotspot is a tab stop | Native behaviour of a and button |
| `ArrowDown` | Move to the nearest hotspot below; focus stays when there is none | Focus on a hotspot |
| `ArrowUp` | Move to the nearest hotspot above; focus stays when there is none | Focus on a hotspot |
| `ArrowRight` | Move to the nearest hotspot to the right; focus stays when there is none | Focus on a hotspot |
| `ArrowLeft` | Move to the nearest hotspot to the left; focus stays when there is none | Focus on a hotspot |
| `Space` | Activate the hotspot as Enter does | Focus on a hotspot that is a link |
| `Enter` | Follow the link or, for click-mode hotspots, toggle the tooltip and focus its first control | Native behaviour of a and button |
| `Escape` | Hide the visible tooltip and, when focus was inside it, return focus to its hotspot | A tooltip is showing |
