# <page-tour>

Progressive-enhancement guided tour. Renders as an in-page step list without JS; enhances to an interactive spotlight overlay with the web component.

- Web component. Needs the Vanilla Breeze script; its children are the fallback when script has not run.
- Documentation: https://vanilla-breeze.com/docs/elements/web-components/page-tour/
- Vanilla Breeze 0.7.4

## Example

```html
<page-tour
  id="demo-tour"
  data-title="Getting Started"
  data-trigger="manual"
  data-mode="passive"
  data-persist="none"
>
  <details class="page-tour-guide" open>
    <summary class="page-tour-summary">
      <span>Getting Started Tour</span>
      <span class="page-tour-count">3 steps</span>
    </summary>
    <ol class="page-tour-list">
      <li>
        <tour-step data-target="#site-header">
          <h3>Header</h3>
          <p>The main navigation lives here.</p>
        </tour-step>
      </li>
      <li>
        <tour-step data-target="#search-input" data-placement="bottom">
          <h3>Search</h3>
          <p>Search across all content.</p>
        </tour-step>
      </li>
      <li>
        <tour-step data-target="#theme-picker" data-placement="bottom">
          <h3>Theme Picker</h3>
          <p>Change the visual style.</p>
        </tour-step>
      </li>
    </ol>
    <button class="page-tour-start-btn" type="button">Start Tour</button>
  </details>
</page-tour>
```

## Attributes

| Attribute | Values | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `data-title` | string | `Page Tour` | Tour name; the accessible name of the tour card |
| `data-trigger` | `auto`, `manual`, `button` | `manual` | How the tour is initiated |
| `data-mode` | `passive`, `active`, `forced` | `passive` | Skip behaviour: passive and active allow skipping (Skip button, Escape, backdrop click); forced removes all three. Action gates come from each step's data-action, not the mode |
| `data-persist` | `none`, `session`, `local` | `session` | Where to store progress |
| `data-persist-key` | string |  | Storage key override (defaults to page path) |
| `data-spotlight-padding` | number |  | Pixel padding around the spotlight; overrides the --tour-spotlight-padding token |
| `data-label-step` | string | `Step {n} of {total}` | Step counter template; {n} and {total} are replaced |
| `data-label-skip` | string | `Skip tour` | Skip button text |
| `data-label-close` | string | `Close` | Skip button text on the last step |
| `data-label-prev` | string | `Previous` | Previous button text |
| `data-label-next` | string | `Next` | Next button text |
| `data-label-finish` | string | `Finish` | Next button text on the last step |
| `data-label-nav` | string | `Tour navigation` | Accessible name of the card's button group |
| `data-label-ready` | string | `Done. Next is available.` | Announced when a step's required action completes |
| `data-step` | number | `0` | Current step index (0-based), reflects state |
| `data-active` | boolean |  | Present while tour is running |
| `data-complete` | boolean |  | Present after tour finishes or is skipped |

## Attributes on children

| Attribute | On | Values | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `data-target` | tour-step | string |  | CSS selector for the element to highlight |
| `data-placement` | tour-step | `top`, `bottom`, `inline-start`, `inline-end`, `auto` | `auto` | Preferred card side; inline-start/inline-end follow the text direction. Flips when there is no room |
| `data-action` | tour-step | `none`, `click`, `focus`, `input`, `change`, `custom` | `none` | Required user action on the target before Next is enabled (custom: the page dispatches tour:action on the <page-tour>) |
| `data-action-hint` | tour-step | string |  | Instructional text shown while waiting for action |
| `data-skippable` | tour-step | `true`, `false` | `true` | false hides Skip and ignores Escape and backdrop clicks on this step (forced mode already does this for every step) |
| `data-scroll` | tour-step | `auto`, `smooth`, `none` | `smooth` | Scroll-into-view behaviour for target |

## Structure

| Child | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `<tour-step>` | Individual tour step — contains heading and description |
| `<details class="page-tour-guide">` | Layer 3 collapsible wrapper (optional) |
| `<button class="page-tour-start-btn">` | Start button inside details (optional, auto-wired) |

## Events

| Event | Detail | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `tour:start` | `{ step }` | Fired once when tour begins |
| `tour:step` | `{ step, target, direction }` | Fired on each step change |
| `tour:action` | `{ step, action }` | Fired when a required action completes |
| `tour:complete` | `{ steps }` | Fired when last step is finished |
| `tour:skip` | `{ step }` | Fired when user skips the tour |

## Methods

| Method | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `start(step?)` | Start at a step index (default 0). While already running, moves to that step instead |
| `stop()` | End the tour silently (no event) |
| `next()` | Advance; ignored while the step's action gate is waiting. On the last step, completes the tour |
| `prev()` | Go to the previous step |
| `goto(index)` | Jump to a step (0-based); steps whose target is missing are skipped |
| `skip()` | Skip the tour (fires tour:skip); ignored when the current step is not skippable |
| `reset()` | Clear persisted progress and reset data-step to 0 |

## CSS custom properties

| Property | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `--tour-backdrop-color` | Overlay colour (default oklch(0% 0 0 / 0.5)) |
| `--tour-spotlight-ring` | Spotlight ring and active pip colour (default var(--color-primary)) |
| `--tour-spotlight-padding` | Space between the target and the spotlight edge (default 8px) |
| `--tour-spotlight-radius` | Spotlight corner radius |
| `--tour-card-max-width` | Maximum card width (default 22rem) |
| `--tour-card-min-width` | Minimum card width (default 16rem) |
| `--tour-card-offset` | Gap between the spotlight and the card |
| `--tour-transition-duration` | Spotlight and backdrop transition duration |
| `--tour-z-index` | Stacking level of the backdrop and spotlight |

## Accessibility

- Pattern: Dialog (modal)
- You provide: A heading (h2 to h4) in each tour-step; it receives focus and is announced
- The component manages: `role="dialog"`, `aria-modal`, `aria-label`, `tabindex`, `aria-hidden`, `aria-live`, `aria-atomic`, `aria-disabled`, `aria-describedby`, `popover`

## Keyboard

| Keys | Action | When |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `Escape` | End the tour and return focus to where it started | Current step is skippable |
| `ArrowRight` / `ArrowDown` | Go to the next step (ArrowRight and ArrowLeft are reversed in right-to-left) | Focus in the tour card or on nothing, not in a form field |
| `ArrowLeft` / `ArrowUp` | Go to the previous step (ArrowRight and ArrowLeft are reversed in right-to-left) | Focus in the tour card or on nothing, not in a form field |
| `Home` | Go to the first step | Focus in the tour card or on nothing, not in a form field |
| `End` | Go to the last step | Focus in the tour card or on nothing, not in a form field |
| `Tab` | Move to the next control in the card, wrapping; on a gated step the target joins the cycle |  |
| `Shift+Tab` | Move to the previous control in the card, wrapping; on a gated step the target joins the cycle |  |

---

# <pager-wc>

Standalone pagination controls element targeting any [data-paged] container. The element form of the data-paged primitive — same shape as the layout-grid / data-layout-* element-attribute symmetry across VB. Authors pick the surface that fits the markup; both feed the same engine. Multiple <pager-wc> instances pointing at the same target stay in sync via paged:change; a target inserted later is picked up.

- Web component. Needs the Vanilla Breeze script; its children are the fallback when script has not run.
- Documentation: https://vanilla-breeze.com/docs/elements/web-components/pager-wc/
- Vanilla Breeze 0.7.4

## Example

```html
<header data-layout="cluster" data-layout-justify="between">
  <h2>Setup steps</h2>
  <pager-wc target="#steps" data-style="prev-next" data-label-nav="Setup steps pages"></pager-wc>
</header>
<ol id="steps" data-paged data-paged-size="4" data-paged-controls="none">
  <li>Set up your account</li>
  <li>Pick a theme</li>
  ...
</ol>
```

## Attributes

| Attribute | Values | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `target` | string |  | CSS selector for the [data-paged] container (preferred form). Only an element carrying data-paged counts; resolution is retried when a paged:change fires and on click. |
| `for` | string |  | ID of the target container (HTML-form-style alternative to target). |
| `data-style` | `numbered`, `prev-next`, `load-more` | `numbered` | Control style. load-more needs a progressive target (data-paged-style="load-more" on the container, plus data-paged-controls="none" to drop its own button). Infinite is intentionally unsupported — a sentinel pattern doesn't make sense for decoupled controls. |
| `data-label-nav` | string | `Pagination` | Accessible name of the rendered <nav> landmark. Give top and bottom pagers distinct names. |
| `data-label-prev` | string | `Previous` | Previous button text. |
| `data-label-next` | string | `Next` | Next button text. |
| `data-label-page` | string | `Page {page}` | Accessible name of each page-number button; {page} is the number. |
| `data-label-status` | string | `Page {page} of {total}` | prev-next status text (polite live region); {page} and {total}. |
| `data-label-load-more` | string | `Load more ({n})` | Load-more button text; {n} is the number of items still hidden. |
| `data-label-no-more` | string | `No more` | Load-more button text once every item is shown. |
| `data-label-missing` | string | `No paginated target found` | Visible note rendered while no [data-paged] target resolves (not a live region). |

## Events

| Event | Detail | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `pager-wc:navigate` | `{ page }` | Bubbles from the pager before it dispatches paged:goto on the target. Fired for page navigations only (numbered / prev-next), not for load-more. Not cancelable. Use for analytics / scroll-restore hooks; listen for paged:change on the target for after-navigation work. |

## Accessibility

- Pattern: Landmark navigation
- You provide: An aria-label on the host when the default name "Pagination" is not specific enough
- The component manages: `aria-label`, `aria-current`, `aria-live`, `aria-hidden`, `role="list"`, `disabled`, `tabindex`

## Keyboard

| Keys | Action | When |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `Enter` / `Space` | Go to the page the focused button names; focus stays on the equivalent button after the controls re-render | Native behaviour of button |

---

# <poll-wc>

Voting + live results. Per-option counts, visible percentages and own-vote flag, single or multi-choice, optional closed (results-only) state. Presentational (reaction-bar pattern): emits poll-wc:vote, marks the option data-pending until the author calls setCount after the server confirms. Can enhance a native <form><fieldset> of radios/checkboxes as a no-JS fallback.

- Web component. Needs the Vanilla Breeze script; its children are the fallback when script has not run.
- Documentation: https://vanilla-breeze.com/docs/elements/web-components/poll-wc/
- Vanilla Breeze 0.7.4

## Example

```html
<poll-wc>
  <span slot="question">When should we ship?</span>
  <button data-option="friday"   data-count="12">Friday</button>
  <button data-option="next-mon" data-count="33" data-mine>Next Monday</button>
  <button data-option="next-fri" data-count="8">Next Friday</button>
  <button data-option="never"    data-count="2">Never</button>
</poll-wc>
```

## Attributes

| Attribute | Values | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `aria-label` | string |  | Group label when there is no question slot; moved onto the option group (the host has no role) |
| `data-multi` | boolean |  | Allow multiple selections (default: single choice) |
| `data-closed` | boolean |  | Read-only — show results, no voting |
| `data-hide-counts` | boolean |  | Hide per-option counts, percentages and bars, visually and from assistive tech |
| `disabled` | boolean |  | Disable voting; observed, so toggling it updates aria-disabled immediately |
| `data-label-vote` | string | `vote` | Singular count noun (Intl.PluralRules "one") |
| `data-label-votes` | string | `votes` | Count noun for other plural categories |
| `data-label-your-choice` | string | `your choice` | Appended to the accessible name of the user's own option |
| `data-label-closed` | string | `closed` | Appended to the total when data-closed is set |
| `data-label-poll` | string | `Poll` | Fallback group name with no question and no aria-label |

## Attributes on children

| Attribute | On | Values | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `data-option` | button | string |  | Stable identifier sent in events |
| `data-count` | button | number |  | Current vote count |
| `data-mine` | button | boolean |  | Current user voted for this option |
| `data-pending` | button | boolean |  | Output: a vote for this option is in flight; further clicks are ignored until setCount/setCounts |

## Events

| Event | Detail | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `poll-wc:vote` | `{ option, action: 'add'\|'remove', count, mine }` | Single-choice: switching options emits a remove for the previously-selected option BEFORE the add. |
| `poll-wc:closed-change` | `{ closed }` | Fires when data-closed is toggled |

## Properties

| Property | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `setCount` | `(option, count, opts?) => void` | Update a single option after the server confirms (or roll back on failure); clears data-pending |
| `setCounts` | `(counts, opts?) => void` | Bulk-update counts; opts.mine accepts a string or string[]; clears every data-pending |
| `open` | `() => void` |  |
| `close` | `() => void` |  |
| `totalVotes` | `number` |  |
| `myVotes` | `string[]` |  |

## Accessibility

- Pattern: Radio group
- You provide: A question element or an aria-label on the host to name the option group
- The component manages: `role="radiogroup"`, `role="radio"`, `role="group"`, `role="checkbox"`, `aria-checked`, `aria-disabled`, `aria-busy`, `aria-label`, `aria-labelledby`, `aria-live`, `aria-hidden`, `tabindex`

## Keyboard

| Keys | Action | When |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `ArrowDown` / `ArrowRight` | Move focus to the next option without voting, wrapping (left and right reversed in right-to-left) | Single choice |
| `ArrowUp` / `ArrowLeft` | Move focus to the previous option without voting, wrapping (left and right reversed in right-to-left) | Single choice |
| `Home` | Move focus to the first option without voting | Single choice |
| `End` | Move focus to the last option without voting | Single choice |
| `Enter` / `Space` | Vote for the focused option, or withdraw the vote | Native behaviour of button |

---

# <pop-over>

General-purpose popover container with CSS Anchor Positioning. Wraps the native Popover API, binds an anchor element (appending to its anchor-name list), and re-asserts display:none under VB's cascade layers. Trigger via the standard popovertarget attribute. The host has no role: authors supply the semantics.

- Web component. Needs the Vanilla Breeze script; its children are the fallback when script has not run.
- Documentation: https://vanilla-breeze.com/docs/elements/web-components/pop-over/
- Vanilla Breeze 0.7.4

## Example

```html
<button popovertarget="prefs">Preferences</button>
<pop-over id="prefs" data-position="bottom-start">
  <p>Pop content here.</p>
</pop-over>
```

## Attributes

| Attribute | Values | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `data-mode` | `auto`, `manual`, `hint` | `auto` | Popover type: 'auto' (default, light-dismiss + Escape, closes other auto popovers), 'manual' (script-only), 'hint' (light-dismiss without closing open auto popovers; falls back to 'auto' where popover="hint" is unsupported). Hover opening is not wired (use interestfor or tool-tip). Changes after upgrade re-apply the popover attribute; an authored popover attribute wins at upgrade. |
| `data-anchor` | string |  | ID (or CSS selector) of the anchor element to position against. If omitted, the component uses the first element whose popovertarget points at this pop-over. Changes after upgrade re-wire the anchor. |
| `data-position` | `top`, `bottom`, `left`, `right`, `top-start`, `top-end`, `bottom-start`, `bottom-end`, `left-start`, `left-end`, `right-start`, `right-end` | `bottom` | Where to place the popover relative to the anchor; -start/-end are logical (mirror in RTL). Flips to the opposite side instead of overflowing the viewport. Default: 'bottom'. |
| `data-offset` | `none`, `xs`, `s`, `m`, `l` | `xs` | Gap between popover and anchor, mapped to --size-* tokens. Default: 'xs'. |
| `data-anchor-name` | string |  | Set by the runtime when an anchor is bound with CSS Anchor Positioning: the dashed-ident appended to the anchor's anchor-name and used as this host's position-anchor. Absent when there is no anchor or no anchor-positioning support. |

## Events

| Event | Detail | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `pop-over:show` | `{ state: 'open' }` | Fired (bubbles, composed) on beforetoggle as the popover opens, whether by popovertarget, show() or showPopover(). |
| `pop-over:hide` | `{ state: 'closed' }` | Fired (bubbles, composed) on beforetoggle as the popover closes, including light-dismiss and Escape. |

## Methods

| Method | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `show()` | Open the popover (no-op if already open). |
| `hide()` | Close the popover (no-op if already closed). |
| `toggle()` | Open if closed, close if open. |

## Properties

| Property | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `open` | `boolean` | Read-only. True while the popover is open (:popover-open). |

## Accessibility

- Pattern: Native popover
- You provide: A trigger button with popovertarget set to the element's id
- The component manages: `popover`

## Keyboard

| Keys | Action | When |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `Escape` | Close the popover | Native behaviour of popover in auto and hint modes |

---

# <popularity-index>

Aggregated most-visited lens. Reads /api/analytics/popular (or any { pages: [{ url, title?, views }] } endpoint), enriches titles/provenance from pages.json, and reflects loading/ready/empty/unavailable state.

- Web component. Needs the Vanilla Breeze script; its children are the fallback when script has not run.
- Documentation: https://vanilla-breeze.com/docs/elements/web-components/popularity-index/
- Vanilla Breeze 0.7.4

## Example

```html
<popularity-index limit="10" window="7d"
                  data-meta-src="/pages.json"></popularity-index>
```

## Attributes

| Attribute | Values | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `analytics-src` | string | `/api/analytics/popular` | Popularity endpoint URL. Re-fetches when changed. |
| `data-meta-src` | string |  | Optional pages.json URL; fills missing titles and adds the provenance chip. Fetched in parallel with the endpoint. |
| `data-lens-src` | string |  | Shared lens pages.json URL (forwarded by content-lens); metadata fallback when data-meta-src is unset. Never used as the endpoint. |
| `limit` | number | `10` | Max entries shown (clamped to at least 1). |
| `window` | string |  | Time window forwarded as ?window=. The VB endpoint accepts 24h, 7d (default) and 30d. |
| `data-heading-level` | number | `2` | Heading level 1-6 for the panel heading; 0 renders no heading (e.g. inside content-lens, which already labels the lens). |
| `data-label-heading` | string | `Most visited` | Heading text. |
| `data-label-view` | string | `view` | Count noun used when Intl.PluralRules selects "one". |
| `data-label-views` | string | `views` | Count noun for every other plural category. |
| `data-label-unavailable` | string | `Popularity data is unavailable right now.` | Message when the endpoint fails (internal error detail is never shown). |
| `data-label-empty` | string | `Not enough data yet to surface most-visited pages.` | Message when the endpoint returns no usable pages. |
| `data-state` | `loading`, `ready`, `empty`, `unavailable` |  | Reflected load state; aria-busy="true" accompanies loading. Hide the panel with popularity-index[data-state="unavailable"] { display: none }. |
| `data-error` | string |  | Internal error detail for debugging when data-state="unavailable" (never rendered). |

## Events

| Event | Detail | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `popularity-index:state` | `{ state }` | Fires when a load settles (ready, empty or unavailable). |

## Accessibility

- Pattern: Native links in an ordered list
- The component manages: `aria-busy`

| `label` | string | `Print this page` | Button label / accessible name. Falls back to the authored text content, then "Print this page" |
| `variant` | `icon`, `label`, `icon-label` | `icon` | icon: printer icon only (label becomes aria-label); label: text only; icon-label: icon and visible text |

# <progress-tracker>

Multi-step progress bar for wizards / checkout / onboarding flows. Distinct from <slide-accept> (slide-to-confirm). Author writes a native <ol> of <li> steps inside the element; the component decorates each with circle + connector + status (complete | current | upcoming | error) and visually hidden status text. With data-clickable, completed steps become native buttons.

- Web component. Needs the Vanilla Breeze script; its children are the fallback when script has not run.
- Documentation: https://vanilla-breeze.com/docs/elements/web-components/progress-tracker/
- Vanilla Breeze 0.7.4

## Example

```html
<progress-tracker data-current="profile" data-label-list="Sign-up progress">
  <ol>
    <li data-step="account">Account</li>
    <li data-step="profile">Profile</li>
    <li data-step="prefs">Preferences</li>
    <li data-step="confirm">Confirm</li>
  </ol>
</progress-tracker>
```

## Attributes

| Attribute | Values | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `data-current` | string |  | Active step: matched against data-step ids first, then as a 1-based index. Defaults to the first step. |
| `data-clickable` | boolean |  | Completed steps render their label inside a native <button> (keyboard and pointer) that navigates back. The current and upcoming steps are not activatable. |
| `data-direction` | `horizontal`, `vertical` | `horizontal` | vertical stacks the steps with a vertical connector (narrow screens, long labels, 5+ steps). |
| `data-label-list` | string | `Progress` | Accessible name set on the <ol> when it has no aria-label / aria-labelledby of its own. |
| `data-label-step` | string | `Step {n} of {total}:` | Visually hidden position prefix read before each label; {n} and {total}. Empty string removes it. |
| `data-label-complete` | string | `(completed)` | Visually hidden status text for completed steps. |
| `data-label-current` | string | `` | Visually hidden status text for the current step (empty by default: aria-current="step" already conveys it). |
| `data-label-upcoming` | string | `(not started)` | Visually hidden status text for upcoming steps. |
| `data-label-error` | string | `(error)` | Visually hidden status text for errored steps. |
| `data-label-announce` | string | `Step {n} of {total}: {label}` | Text announced to screen readers when the current step changes; {n}, {total} and {label} (the step's label text). |

## Attributes on children

| Attribute | On | Values | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `data-step` | li | string |  | Stable step id (any string; defaults to the 1-based position). data-current matches it before trying an index, so numeric ids like "2024" are safe. |
| `data-error` | li | boolean |  | Marks this step as errored regardless of position. |
| `data-status` | li | `complete`, `current`, `upcoming`, `error` |  | Set by the component; style hook. |
| `aria-current` | li | string |  | Set by the component to "step" on the current step. |

## Structure

| Child | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `ol` | Required native ordered list of steps (renders as a plain numbered list without JS). |

## Events

| Event | Detail | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `progress-tracker:step` | `{ step, previousStep, source: 'attr'\|'click' }` | Bubbles when data-current changes after upgrade (source 'attr') or a completed step is activated in data-clickable mode (source 'click', one event only). Not fired on upgrade or when the current step is activated. |

## CSS custom properties

| Property | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `--pt-circle-size` | Diameter of the step circle (default 1.75rem). |
| `--pt-line-thickness` | Connector and circle border thickness (default 2px). |
| `--pt-color-complete` | Fill / connector colour for completed steps (default --color-success). |
| `--pt-color-current` | Outline / ring colour for the active step (default --color-interactive). |
| `--pt-color-upcoming` | Outline / connector colour for upcoming steps (default --color-border). |
| `--pt-color-error` | Fill / connector colour for errored steps (default --color-error). |
| `--pt-color-text-on-fill` | Glyph colour on filled (complete / error) circles (default --color-text-on-interactive-auto). |

## Accessibility

- Pattern: Native ordered list of steps
- You provide: An <ol> whose items carry a text label for each step
- The component manages: `aria-current`, `aria-label`, `aria-hidden`

## Keyboard

| Keys | Action | When |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `Enter` / `Space` | Go back to the focused completed step | Native behaviour of button; completed steps with data-clickable |

---

# <qr-code>

QR code generator: black-on-white canvas with quiet zone, author children kept as the caption

- Web component. Needs the Vanilla Breeze script; its children are the fallback when script has not run.
- Documentation: https://vanilla-breeze.com/docs/elements/web-components/qr-code/
- Vanilla Breeze 0.7.4

## Example

```html
<qr-code value="https://vanilla-breeze.com" data-caption="visible">
  <a href="https://vanilla-breeze.com">vanilla-breeze.com</a>
</qr-code>

<!-- No value attribute: the text content is encoded -->
<qr-code data-caption="visible">Hello, World!</qr-code>
```

## Attributes

| Attribute | Values | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `value` | string |  | The text/URL to encode. Falls back to the element's original text content. Reactive; removing it falls back to the text again. |
| `size` | number | `200` | Edge of the drawn box in CSS pixels, quiet zone included. Modules are a whole number of device pixels. Reactive. |
| `color` | string | `#000` | Module colour (any CSS colour). Opt-in; logs a console warning when the pair is inverted, low-contrast or translucent. Reactive. |
| `background` | string | `#fff` | Background colour, always painted, including the 4-module quiet zone. Reactive. |
| `error-correction` | `l`, `m`, `q`, `h`, `0`, `1`, `2`, `3` | `m` | Error-correction level: L (7%), M (15%, default), Q (25%), H (30%), or 0-3. Letters are case-insensitive (listed lower-case because html-validate matches enums lower-cased); other values warn and use M. Reactive. |
| `data-caption` | `visible` |  | Show the caption (the element's children) under the code. By default it is visually hidden but read by screen readers, and shown while a link inside it has focus. A plain-text caption that only repeats the value is hidden from screen readers while the canvas name carries the value. |
| `data-label-prefix` | string |  | Accessible name of the canvas (role=img). Without it the name is "QR code: " followed by the encoded value (cut to 200 characters with an ellipsis when longer). With it, this text is the name and the encoded value is the canvas's aria-description. |
| `data-label-copied` | string | `QR code copied` | Screen-reader announcement after copy() succeeds. |
| `data-error` | `capacity`, `encoding` |  | Set when no code could be drawn (the text is longer than the level holds, or cannot be encoded). The caption is then shown. |

## Events

| Event | Detail | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `qr-code:error` | `{ reason: 'capacity' \| 'encoding', value, errorCorrection: 'L' \| 'M' \| 'Q' \| 'H', message }` | Fired when the value cannot be encoded. No code is drawn and the caption (fallback) stays visible. |
| `qr-code:upgraded` |  | Fired once the element has upgraded (canvas and caption in place). |

## Methods

| Method | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `toDataURL(type?)` | Returns the code as a data URL (default image/png): opaque, quiet zone included. '' when no code is drawn. |
| `copy(options?)` | Copies the code to the clipboard as text/plain (the encoded value) + image/png. Falls back to text-only without ClipboardItem support. options.button gets data-state="copied" and a copy event. Resolves false when no code is drawn. |

## Properties

| Property | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `value` | `string` | The encoded text. Setting it sets the value attribute; '' or null removes it. |

## Accessibility

- Pattern: Image
- You provide: A data-label-prefix when the code needs a name of its own; the encoded value is then its description
- The component manages: `role="img"`, `aria-label`, `aria-description`, `aria-hidden`, `hidden`

---

# <reaction-bar>

GitHub-style emoji reaction picker. Persistent bar of reaction chips with counts + a trigger that opens a curated palette popover. Composes pop-over for the palette surface.

- Web component. Needs the Vanilla Breeze script; its children are the fallback when script has not run.
- Documentation: https://vanilla-breeze.com/docs/elements/web-components/reaction-bar/
- Vanilla Breeze 0.7.4

## Example

```html
<reaction-bar aria-label="Reactions to comment 482">
  <button data-reaction="thumbsup" data-label="Thumbs up" data-count="3" data-mine>👍</button>
  <button data-reaction="rocket"   data-label="Rocket"    data-count="2">🚀</button>
  <template data-palette>
    <button data-reaction="thumbsup"   data-label="Thumbs up">👍</button>
    <button data-reaction="thumbsdown" data-label="Thumbs down">👎</button>
    <button data-reaction="laugh"      data-label="Laugh">😄</button>
    <button data-reaction="hooray"     data-label="Hooray">🎉</button>
    <button data-reaction="confused"   data-label="Confused">😕</button>
    <button data-reaction="heart"      data-label="Heart">❤️</button>
    <button data-reaction="rocket"     data-label="Rocket">🚀</button>
    <button data-reaction="eyes"       data-label="Eyes">👀</button>
  </template>
</reaction-bar>
```

## Attributes

| Attribute | Values | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `aria-label` | string |  | Toolbar label (default: data-label-toolbar, then "Reactions"). Also names the palette group. |
| `data-trigger-icon` | string |  | Text/emoji content of the trigger button (default "😀") |
| `data-trigger-label` | string |  | aria-label for the trigger (default "Add reaction") |
| `data-label-toolbar` | string |  | Default toolbar label when no aria-label is authored (default "Reactions") |
| `data-label-dialog` | string |  | aria-label of the palette dialog (default "Choose a reaction") |
| `data-label-count-one` | string |  | Count phrase in chip names for the Intl.PluralRules "one" category; {count} is replaced by the Intl.NumberFormat count (default "{count} reaction"). Any CLDR category works: data-label-count-zero, -two, -few, -many. |
| `data-label-count-other` | string |  | Count phrase for every category without its own data-label-count-* (default "{count} reactions"). Locale comes from the closest [lang]. |
| `data-disabled` | boolean |  | Read-only mode, observed: chips get aria-disabled and do not toggle, the trigger is disabled and leaves the roving tab order, an open palette closes |

## Attributes on children

| Attribute | On | Values | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `data-reaction` | button | string |  | Stable identifier sent to the backend (e.g. thumbsup, heart) |
| `data-count` | button | number |  | Current count (≥ 1 to show; 0 removes the chip) |
| `data-mine` | button | boolean |  | Whether the current user has this reaction (exposed as aria-pressed) |
| `data-label` | button | string |  | Accessible name of the reaction (e.g. "Thumbs up"), on chips and palette buttons; an authored aria-label works too. Falls back to the emoji. |
| `data-pending` | button | boolean |  | Output: a toggle for this chip is in flight (also aria-busy); further clicks are ignored until setCount() |
| `data-palette` | template | boolean |  | Marks a <template> child as the available-reactions palette |

## Events

| Event | Detail | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `reaction-bar:toggle` |  | Fires when a chip or palette option is clicked. detail: { reaction, action: 'add'\|'remove', count, mine } — count and mine are the values BEFORE the toggle. The chip is then data-pending until setCount() is called for that reaction. |
| `reaction-bar:palette-open` |  | Fires when the palette popover opens |
| `reaction-bar:palette-close` |  | Fires when the palette popover closes |

## Methods

| Method | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `setCount(reaction, count, { mine })` | Update a chip after the server confirms (call it on failure too, with the old values, to roll back). Clears the pending state, creates the chip from the palette template button (keeping its data-label) if missing, and removes the chip at count 0 — focus moves to a neighbour if the chip had it. |
| `openPalette()` | Open the palette popover (no-op while data-disabled) |
| `closePalette()` | Close the palette popover |

## Accessibility

- Pattern: Toolbar
- You provide: A data-label or aria-label on each reaction button that names the emoji
- The component manages: `role="toolbar"`, `aria-label`, `tabindex`, `aria-pressed`, `aria-busy`, `aria-disabled`, `aria-haspopup`, `aria-expanded`, `role="dialog"`, `role="group"`, `aria-hidden`, `popovertarget`

## Keyboard

| Keys | Action | When |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `ArrowRight` | Move to the next chip or the add-reaction trigger, wrapping (reversed in right-to-left) | Focus in the toolbar |
| `ArrowLeft` | Move to the previous chip or the add-reaction trigger, wrapping (reversed in right-to-left) | Focus in the toolbar |
| `ArrowRight` / `ArrowDown` | Move to the next palette option, wrapping (left and right reversed in right-to-left) | Focus in the palette |
| `ArrowLeft` / `ArrowUp` | Move to the previous palette option, wrapping (left and right reversed in right-to-left) | Focus in the palette |
| `Home` | Move to the first item of the toolbar or palette |  |
| `End` | Move to the last item of the toolbar or palette |  |
| `Escape` | Close the palette | Native behaviour of popover |

# <reader-view>

Immersive reading shell with scroll and paged modes. Moves its children into a layout-columns surface with a chrome bar, page navigation, font and column controls.

- Web component. Needs the Vanilla Breeze script; its children are the fallback when script has not run.
- Documentation: https://vanilla-breeze.com/docs/elements/web-components/reader-view/
- Vanilla Breeze 0.7.4

## Example

```html
<reader-view>
  <article data-prose>
    <h1>Article Title</h1>
    <p>Content renders in scroll mode by default.
    Click Pages for paged reading.</p>
  </article>
</reader-view>
```

## Attributes

| Attribute | Values | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `mode` | `scroll`, `pages` | `scroll` | Reading mode. Observed and reflected. pages is a full-viewport overlay: the rest of the page is made inert, document scroll is locked, focus moves into the pager, Escape returns to scroll. |
| `columns` | `auto`, `1`, `2`, `3` | `auto` | Column count in pages mode. Observed and reflected. |
| `font-controls` | `true`, `false` | `true` | Set to false to omit the font-size buttons from the default chrome. |
| `col-controls` | `true`, `false` | `true` | Set to false to omit the column picker from the default chrome. |
| `reader-title` | string |  | Chrome bar title. Falls back to the first <h1>, then document.title. |
| `persist` | `true`, `false` | `true` | Set to false to disable localStorage persistence of font size, columns (and mode with data-remember-mode). |
| `storage-key` | string |  | localStorage key. Defaults to vb-reader:<location.pathname>, plus #<id> when the element has an id. |
| `data-remember-mode` | boolean |  | Opt in to restoring the persisted mode (including pages) on load. Without it only font size and columns are restored; an authored mode attribute always wins. |
| `data-label-kicker` | string | `Reader` | Override the "Reader" string. |
| `data-label-controls` | string | `Reading controls` | Override the "Reading controls" string. |
| `data-label-mode-group` | string | `Reading mode` | Override the "Reading mode" string. |
| `data-label-mode` | string | `Mode` | Override the "Mode" string. |
| `data-label-scroll` | string | `Scroll` | Override the "Scroll" string. |
| `data-label-pages` | string | `Pages` | Override the "Pages" string. |
| `data-label-font-group` | string | `Font size` | Override the "Font size" string. |
| `data-label-type` | string | `Type` | Override the "Type" string. |
| `data-label-font-decrease` | string | `Decrease font size` | Override the "Decrease font size" string. |
| `data-label-font-increase` | string | `Increase font size` | Override the "Increase font size" string. |
| `data-label-columns-group` | string | `Page columns` | Override the "Page columns" string. |
| `data-label-cols` | string | `Cols` | Override the "Cols" string. |
| `data-label-auto` | string | `Auto` | Override the "Auto" string. |
| `data-label-column-auto` | string | `Auto columns` | Override the "Auto columns" string. |
| `data-label-column-1` | string | `1 column` | Override the "1 column" string. |
| `data-label-column-2` | string | `2 columns` | Override the "2 columns" string. |
| `data-label-column-3` | string | `3 columns` | Override the "3 columns" string. |
| `data-label-pages-region` | string | `Article pages` | Override the "Article pages" string. |
| `data-label-page-nav` | string | `Page navigation` | Override the "Page navigation" string. |
| `data-label-prev` | string | `Previous page` | Override the "Previous page" string. |
| `data-label-next` | string | `Next page` | Override the "Next page" string. |
| `data-label-page-indicator` | string | `{page} / {total}` | Override the "{page} / {total}" string ({page} and {total} are replaced). |

## Attributes on children

| Attribute | On | Values | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `data-reader-action` | button | `toggle-mode`, `set-mode-scroll`, `set-mode-pages`, `font-increase`, `font-decrease`, `set-columns`, `prev-page`, `next-page` |  | Action wired by click delegation (default and slotted chrome). |
| `data-reader-value` | button | `auto`, `1`, `2`, `3` |  | Column value for data-reader-action="set-columns". |
| `data-reader-output` | output | `page-indicator`, `mode-label` |  | Filled by the runtime with the page indicator text or the current mode label. |
| `aria-pressed` | button | `true`, `false` |  | Set by the runtime on set-mode-*, set-columns and toggle-mode buttons (runtime). |
| `data-reader-state` | button | `active`, (no value) |  | Styling hook mirroring aria-pressed on mode and column buttons (runtime). |

## Slots

| Slot | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `chrome` | Replaces the default chrome bar. Wire controls with data-reader-action / data-reader-value / data-reader-output. |

## Events

| Event | Detail | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `reader-view:mode` | `{ mode: 'scroll' \| 'pages' }` | Mode changed (not fired for the initial mode on upgrade). |
| `reader-view:page` | `{ page: number, total: number }` | Current page changed in pages mode (page is 1-based). |
| `reader-view:font` | `{ size: string, index: number }` | Font size stepped up or down. |

## CSS custom properties

| Property | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `--reader-view-z` | z-index of the pages-mode overlay (default var(--z-overlay)). |

## Accessibility

- Pattern: Toggle buttons with a paged region
- The component manages: `role="region"`, `role="group"`, `aria-label`, `aria-pressed`, `aria-live`, `aria-hidden`, `inert`, `tabindex`

## Keyboard

| Keys | Action | When |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `Escape` | Return to scroll mode and move focus to the mode toggle | Pages mode |
| `ArrowRight` / `PageDown` | Go to the next page (arrow reversed in right-to-left) | Pages mode, focus not in a form field |
| `ArrowLeft` / `PageUp` | Go to the previous page (arrow reversed in right-to-left) | Pages mode, focus not in a form field |
| `Space` | Go to the next page | Pages mode, focus not on a button, link or form field |
| `Shift+Space` | Go to the previous page | Pages mode, focus not on a button, link or form field |
| `Home` | Go to the first page | Pages mode, focus not in a form field |
| `End` | Go to the last page | Pages mode, focus not in a form field |

# <reading-progress>

Decorative fixed-position scroll progress bar (CSS scroll-timeline for the document, JS for data-for targets).

- Web component. Needs the Vanilla Breeze script; its children are the fallback when script has not run.


## Attributes

| Attribute | Values | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |

| `data-position` | `top`, `bottom` | `top` | Viewport edge the bar is anchored to. |

## Structure

| Child | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `progress` | Optional SSR child; created when absent. Always aria-hidden: the bar is decorative. |

## Accessibility

- Pattern: Decorative progress bar
- The component manages: `aria-hidden`

# <recently-visited>

Device-local reader history lens (localStorage, never sent or aggregated). Pages are recorded only when opted in with <meta name="vb:track-history" content="on"> or by this element's presence; <html data-vb-no-track> and <meta name="vb:no-track-history"> opt out.

- Web component. Needs the Vanilla Breeze script; its children are the fallback when script has not run.
- Documentation: https://vanilla-breeze.com/docs/elements/web-components/recently-visited/
- Vanilla Breeze 0.7.4

## Example

```html
<recently-visited limit="20"></recently-visited>
```

## Attributes

| Attribute | Values | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `limit` | number | `25` | Max page groups rendered. Storage itself is capped separately at 100 entries by the tracker. |
| `include-current` | boolean |  | Also list the page the reader is on (excluded by default). |
| `data-heading-level` | number | `2` | Heading level 1-6 for the panel heading; 0 renders no heading (e.g. inside content-lens). |
| `data-label-heading` | string | `Recently visited` | Heading text. |
| `data-label-explainer` | string | `Stored on this device only. Never sent to a server.` | Privacy note under the heading. |
| `data-label-pause` | string | `Pause tracking` | Pause toggle label (static; aria-pressed carries the state). |
| `data-label-anchors` | string | `Show anchor visits` | Anchor-visits toggle label (static; aria-pressed carries the state). |
| `data-label-clear` | string | `Clear history` | Clear button label. |
| `data-label-empty` | string | `No recently visited pages yet.` | Message rendered when there is no history. |
| `data-label-anchor-one` | string | `anchor` | Anchor count noun when Intl.PluralRules selects "one". |
| `data-label-anchor-other` | string | `anchors` | Anchor count noun for every other plural category. |

## Events

| Event | Detail | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `recently-visited:clear` |  | Fires when the reader clears the local history. |
| `recently-visited:pause-toggle` | `{ paused }` | Fires when the reader pauses or resumes tracking. |
| `recently-visited:anchors-toggle` | `{ showAnchors }` | Fires when the reader shows or hides anchor visits. |

## Properties

| Property | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `entries` | `Array<{ url, hash, title, hashTitle, ts }>` | Read-only. Stored history, most recent first; expired (30-day TTL), malformed and off-origin records are filtered out. |

## Accessibility

- Pattern: Button
- The component manages: `aria-pressed`, `aria-disabled`, `aria-label`

## Keyboard

| Keys | Action | When |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `Enter` / `Space` | Toggle pause, toggle anchors or clear the history | Native behaviour of button |

# <score-card>

Single KPI tile for dashboards: title, headline value, optional change indicator, sparkline (composed with <chart-wc>), description, and icon. Wrap in <a href> for drill-down. Slotted children must be direct children of the host.

- Web component. Needs the Vanilla Breeze script; its children are the fallback when script has not run.
- Documentation: https://vanilla-breeze.com/docs/elements/web-components/score-card/
- Vanilla Breeze 0.7.4

## Example

```html
<score-card>
  <span slot="title">Orders</span>
  <data slot="value" value="1429">1,429</data>
</score-card>
```

## Attributes

| Attribute | Values | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `trend` | `up`, `down`, `flat` |  | Drives change-indicator color and exposes :state(trend-up\|trend-down\|trend-flat) |
| `tone` | `default`, `success`, `warning`, `error`, `info` |  | Optional accent color applied to the icon slot |
| `layout` | `stack`, `cluster`, `compact` |  | Grid template variant: vertical stack, icon-cluster row, or dense compact |
| `loading` | boolean |  | Skeleton placeholder state via :state(loading); mirrored to aria-busy="true" on the host |

## Slots

| Slot | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `title` | Metric label |
| `value` | Headline number — use <data value="..."> for machine-readable values |
| `change` | Delta indicator — recommend nested <data> for the change value |
| `sparkline` | Trend visualisation — compose with <chart-wc data-type="line\|area"> or any sized element |
| `description` | Supporting context line below the metric |
| `icon` | Brand or category icon (recommend <icon-wc>) |

## Parts

| Part | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `card` | Outer grid container |
| `title` | Title slot wrapper |
| `value` | Value slot wrapper |
| `change` | Change slot wrapper |
| `sparkline` | Sparkline slot wrapper |
| `description` | Description slot wrapper |
| `icon` | Icon slot wrapper |

## Accessibility

- Pattern: Static content
- The component manages: `aria-busy`

# <selection-menu>

Floating toolbar that appears on text selection (pointer or keyboard). Moves its authored action children into a generated <pop-over data-mode="manual" role="toolbar"> in the top layer; Alt+F10 focuses it, arrow keys rove, Escape returns focus and the selection.

- Web component. Needs the Vanilla Breeze script; its children are the fallback when script has not run.
- Documentation: https://vanilla-breeze.com/docs/elements/web-components/selection-menu/
- Vanilla Breeze 0.7.4

## Example

```html
<selection-menu for="my-article">
  <highlight-wc></highlight-wc>
  <share-wc></share-wc>
  <note-wc></note-wc>
  <comment-wc></comment-wc>
</selection-menu>

<article id="my-article">
  <p>Select text here to see the toolbar.</p>
</article>
```

## Attributes

| Attribute | Values | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `for` | string |  | ID of a single target element to watch for text selection. When the menu also has an id, the target is marked data-selection-menu="<id>". |
| `id` | string |  | When set, every element with data-selection-menu="<id>" is a target (many-to-one); targets added or changed later are picked up. |
| `data-label` | string | `Text selection actions` | Accessible name of the toolbar (aria-label on the composed pop-over) |

## Attributes on children

| Attribute | On | Values | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `data-selection-menu` | any element | string |  | On a target element: the id of the selection-menu that serves it |

## Structure

| Child | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `<pop-over data-selection-menu-host role="toolbar">` | Generated toolbar surface; setup() moves the authored children into it. Style this node, not the host (the host is display: contents). |
| `<highlight-wc>` | Text highlighting with color palette |
| `<share-wc>` | Share or copy the selected text as a quote (detected via closest('selection-menu')) |
| `<note-wc>` | Private note on highlight |
| `<comment-wc>` | Inline comment on a review-surface (from @profpowell/vb-project-planning) |

## Events

| Event | Detail | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `selection-menu:select` | `{ range: Range, text: string, target: Element }` | A selection inside a target opened (or moved) the toolbar |
| `selection-menu:dismiss` |  | The toolbar was hidden (outside pointerdown, Escape, dismiss(), selection collapsed from the keyboard, or scrolled out of view) |
| `selection-menu:actions-changed` | `{ actions: Array<{ tag, attrs?, html? }>, source: 'property' }` | The actions property replaced the toolbar children |

## Methods

| Method | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `getSelection` | The selection the toolbar is showing for (a cloned range), or null when hidden |
| `dismiss` | Hide the toolbar; focus inside it returns to the selection's target |

## Properties

| Property | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `actions` | `Array<{ tag: string, attrs?: object, html?: string } \| Element>` | Toolbar children as plain data; setting it replaces them and fires selection-menu:actions-changed |

## Accessibility

- Pattern: Toolbar
- You provide: Child buttons or links that each have an accessible name
- The component manages: `role="toolbar"`, `aria-orientation`, `aria-label`, `aria-keyshortcuts`, `tabindex`, `popover`, `hidden`

## Keyboard

| Keys | Action | When |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `Alt+F10` | Open the toolbar for the current selection if needed and focus its first item | Text is selected |
| `Escape` | Close the toolbar; if focus was in it, return focus and the selection to the text | Toolbar open |
| `ArrowRight` | Move to the next item, wrapping (reversed in right-to-left) | Focus in the toolbar |
| `ArrowLeft` | Move to the previous item, wrapping (reversed in right-to-left) | Focus in the toolbar |
| `Home` | Move to the first item | Focus in the toolbar |
| `End` | Move to the last item | Focus in the toolbar |

---

## Attributes on children

| Attribute | On | Values | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `data-trigger` | button | boolean |  | Marks an authored trigger button (else the first child <button>, else a minted gear button). The runtime sets aria-haspopup, aria-expanded and aria-controls on it. |

## Events

| Event | Detail | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `settings-panel:upgraded` |  | Fired on the host (bubbles) once the element has upgraded and rendered. |
| `settings-panel:data-changed` | `{ data, source: 'property' }` | Fired on the host (bubbles) after a data setter's VBStore writes finish. |
| `vb:a11y-themes-change` | `string[]` | Dispatched on window (not the host) when the accessibility themes change; also listened for, so other components can push changes in. |
| `vb:extensions-change` | `{ motionFx, sounds, charShortcuts }` | Dispatched on window (not the host) when the effects preferences change; also listened for (theme-picker dispatches it too). |

## Methods

| Method | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `open` | Open the panel and move focus into it. Queued if called before the element has rendered. |
| `close` | Close the panel. When focus is inside the panel it returns to the trigger; focus elsewhere is not moved. |
| `toggle` | Toggle the panel open/closed. |

## Properties

| Property | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `data` | `{ a11yThemes: string[], extensions: { motionFx: boolean, sounds: boolean, charShortcuts: boolean }, sticky: boolean }` | Settings snapshot. The setter applies each provided field to the page at once (a11y themes on <html data-theme>, extensions incl. <html data-motion-reduced> and <html data-char-shortcuts="off">, <html data-sticky>), writes it through to VBStore (vb:settings:a11y / extensions / sticky), updates the controls, and fires settings-panel:data-changed when the writes finish. Safe before the panel renders. |

## Accessibility

- Pattern: Dialog (non-modal)
- The component manages: `aria-haspopup`, `aria-expanded`, `aria-controls`, `aria-label`, `role="dialog"`, `tabindex`, `role="status"`, `role="group"`, `aria-labelledby`, `aria-hidden`, `hidden`

## Keyboard

| Keys | Action | When |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `Escape` | Close the panel; focus returns to the trigger when it was inside the panel | Panel open and focus on the trigger or inside the panel |
| `Enter` / `Space` | Open or close a settings section | Native behaviour of summary |

# <share-wc>

Social share component: native Web Share button (falls back to copying the link), platform buttons, or enhanced slotted links; inside selection-menu, shares or copies the selected text as a quote.

- Web component. Needs the Vanilla Breeze script; its children are the fallback when script has not run.
- Documentation: https://vanilla-breeze.com/docs/elements/web-components/share/
- Vanilla Breeze 0.7.4

## Example

```html
<share-wc></share-wc>
```

## Attributes

| Attribute | Values | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `url` | string |  | URL to share (default: <link rel=canonical>, then location.href) |
| `title` | string |  | Share title (default: og:title, then document.title). Read from the attribute; the JS property is shareTitle. |
| `text` | string |  | Share description (default: meta description, then og:description) |
| `platforms` | string | `x,linkedin,bluesky,mastodon,whatsapp,email,copy` | Comma-separated platform list (x, twitter, facebook, linkedin, whatsapp, telegram, bluesky, mastodon, email, copy) or "native-only" |
| `variant` | `icon`, `label`, `icon-label` | `icon-label` | Icon only (label visually hidden but still the name), label only, or both |
| `size` | `s`, `m`, `l` | `m` | Button size |
| `label` | string | `Share` | Visible label (and accessible name) of the native share button |
| `color` | boolean |  | Brand colours on each platform button's border and icon (label text stays --color-text) |
| `mastodon-instance` | string | `mastodon.social` | Mastodon instance |
| `tier` | `native`, `platforms` |  | Force a tier instead of auto-detecting navigator.share (native without support resolves to hidden) |
| `data-tier-resolved` | `native`, `platforms`, `hidden`, `selection` |  | The tier the component rendered |
| `data-label-share-page` | string | `Share this page` | Accessible name of the share button group |
| `data-label-share-on` | string | `Share on {platform}` | Platform button name; {platform} is replaced by the platform label |
| `data-label-copy` | string | `Copy link` | Copy button label |
| `data-label-copied` | string | `Copied!` | Copy button label for 2s after copying |
| `data-label-link-copied` | string | `Link copied to clipboard` | Announced after the link is copied |
| `data-label-share-selection` | string | `Share selection` | Selection-menu button name |
| `data-label-selection-copied` | string | `Selection copied` | Announced after a selection quote is copied |

## Attributes on children

| Attribute | On | Values | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `data-platform` | a, button (slotted) | string |  | Marks a slotted link/button as a platform; "copy" copies the URL. {url}, {title}, {text} tokens in href are substituted (encoded). |

## Events

| Event | Detail | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `share-wc:open` | `{ platform: string }` | A share was started (platform id or 'native') |
| `share-wc:success` | `{ platform: string }` | A share window opened, the native share resolved, or the link was copied ('copy') |
| `share-wc:error` | `{ platform: string, error?: Error }` | Native share failed (not cancelled) or the clipboard write failed |

## Methods

| Method | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `share` | Native tier: open the share sheet (copying the link if it fails). Other tiers: copy the link. Resolves true when shared or copied. |

## Properties

| Property | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `url` | `string` | Shared URL; setting it wins over the attribute, re-substitutes slotted {url} tokens and survives reconnect |
| `shareTitle` | `string` | Shared title (named to avoid shadowing HTMLElement.title); same override rules as url |
| `text` | `string` | Shared description; same override rules as url |

## Accessibility

- Pattern: Native buttons in a named group
- The component manages: `role="group"`, `aria-label`, `aria-hidden`

## Keyboard

| Keys | Action | When |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `Enter` / `Space` | Share to the platform, copy the link or open the system share sheet | Native behaviour of button |

# <short-cuts>

Keyboard shortcuts help overlay: a modal dialog listing the command registry ([data-command][data-shortcut]) and data-hotkey actions, toggled by ? (remappable or off) or show()/toggle().

- Web component. Needs the Vanilla Breeze script; its children are the fallback when script has not run.
- Documentation: https://vanilla-breeze.com/docs/elements/web-components/shortcuts/
- Vanilla Breeze 0.7.4

## Example

```html
<!-- Place once per page, typically in your layout -->
<short-cuts></short-cuts>

<!-- A visible way in for pointer and touch users -->
<button type="button" id="open-shortcuts">Keyboard shortcuts</button>
<script type="module">
  document.getElementById('open-shortcuts')
    .addEventListener('click', () => document.querySelector('short-cuts').show());
</script>
```

## Attributes

| Attribute | Values | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `hotkey` | string | `shift+?` | Key combo that toggles the dialog; "none" disables the character-key shortcut (WCAG 2.1.4). A character-key combo also stops firing, and unscoped character-key shortcuts are left out of the dialog, while <html data-char-shortcuts="off"> is set (settings-panel Single-Key Shortcuts preference). Observed. |
| `data-label-title` | string | `Keyboard shortcuts` | Dialog heading and accessible name |
| `data-label-general` | string | `General` | Group holding the component's own shortcut |
| `data-label-self` | string | `Show keyboard shortcuts` | Label of the component's own shortcut |
| `data-label-close` | string | `Close` | Close button accessible name |

## Attributes on children

| Attribute | On | Values | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `data-shortcut` | [data-command] (anywhere in the page) | string |  | Command-registry source: label from data-command, group from data-command-group |
| `data-hotkey` | any non-kbd element (anywhere in the page) | string |  | Hotkey-action source: label from data-hotkey-label or text, group from data-hotkey-group (default "Page Actions") |

## Events

| Event | Detail | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `short-cuts:shortcuts-changed` | `{ shortcuts: Record<string, Array<{ label, shortcut }>> \| null, source: 'property' }` | The shortcuts property was set |

## Methods

| Method | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `show` | Open the dialog (rebuilds the list from the current sources) |
| `close` | Close the dialog |
| `toggle` | Open when closed, close when open |

## Properties

| Property | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `shortcuts` | `Record<string, Array<{ label: string, shortcut: string }>> \| null` | Override list keyed by group name; replaces the registry sources (the component's own hotkey is still listed). null restores the registries. |
| `open` | `boolean` | Whether the dialog is open |
| `hotkey` | `string \| null` | Active combo, or null when hotkey="none" |

## Accessibility

- Pattern: Native dialog
- The component manages: `aria-labelledby`, `aria-label`, `aria-hidden`

## Keyboard

| Keys | Action | When |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `?` | Open or close the shortcuts dialog (the key is set by the hotkey attribute) | Focus anywhere on the page except in a form field, while character shortcuts are enabled |
| `Escape` | Close the dialog | Native behaviour of dialog |

---

# <site-index>

Interactive keyword index: one filter box, an A–Z jump strip, a term count per letter and an optional display limit over a hand-authored (or src JSON) index

- Web component. Needs the Vanilla Breeze script; its children are the fallback when script has not run.
- Documentation: https://vanilla-breeze.com/docs/elements/web-components/site-index/
- Vanilla Breeze 0.7.4

## Example

```html
<site-index letters="all" limit="5">
  <nav aria-label="Site index">
    <section id="index-a">
      <h2>A</h2>
      <ul>
        <li>
          <span class="index-term">accessibility</span>
          <ul class="index-refs">
            <li><a href="/docs/accessibility">Guide</a></li>
            <li><a href="/docs/elements/native/input#aria">
              Input ARIA</a></li>
          </ul>
        </li>
        <li>
          <span class="index-term">attributes</span>
          <ul class="index-refs">
            <li><a href="/docs/attributes/">Reference</a></li>
            <li><a href="/docs/attributes/data-provenance/">
              data-provenance</a></li>
          </ul>
        </li>
      </ul>
    </section>
  </nav>
</site-index>
```

## Attributes

| Attribute | Values | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `placeholder` | string | `Filter index…` | Placeholder and accessible name of the filter input |
| `letters` | `entries`, `all`, `none` | `entries` | Jump strip: letters that have entries, the full A–Z plus any other letters present (É, Å…), or none |
| `filter` | `all`, `topic` | `all` | What the filter box matches: terms and the titles of the pages they point to, or terms only |
| `limit` | number |  | Max entries per letter before a "Show N more" toggle |
| `src` | string |  | URL of index JSON ([{ term, refs: [{ href, label, type? }] }]) that replaces the authored nav. Strings render as text; only http(s), relative and fragment hrefs become links. |
| `data-label-controls` | string | `Filter the index` | Accessible name of the controls search landmark |
| `data-label-jump` | string | `Jump to letter` | Accessible name of the letter strip |
| `data-label-terms` | string | `{count} terms` | Term count beside each letter heading and as the hover hint on its jump letter ({count} is replaced) |
| `data-label-terms-one` | string | `1 term` | Term count for a letter with one term |
| `data-label-more` | string | `Show {count} more` | Show-more button ({count} is replaced) |
| `data-label-less` | string | `Show less` | Show-less button |
| `data-label-matches` | string | `{count} terms match` | Live filter count ({count} is replaced) |
| `data-label-matches-one` | string | `1 term matches` | Live filter count for one match |
| `data-label-no-matches` | string | `No matches` | Live status when the filter matches nothing |

## Attributes on children

| Attribute | On | Values | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `data-index` | nav | boolean |  | Explicitly marks the index nav (otherwise the direct-child nav holding sections is used) |

## Structure

| Child | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `<nav>` | The index: a direct-child <nav> of <section id="index-x"> letter groups (or any <nav data-index>). Any aria-label works. |
| `<section id="index-x">` | One letter group — <h2> plus <ul> of terms. The letter comes from the id, so index-é gives É. |
| `<span class="index-term">` | The term text inside each <li> |
| `<ul class="index-refs">` | Page references for a term |

## Accessibility

- Pattern: Landmark navigation
- You provide: A <nav> with an aria-label holding one <section> per letter, each with an <h2> and a list of terms
- The component manages: `role="status"`, `aria-label`, `aria-current`, `aria-disabled`, `aria-expanded`, `tabindex`, `hidden`

# <site-legal>

Legal and compliance content container for copyright, license, privacy, and terms links

- CSS-only custom element. Works without JavaScript.
- Documentation: https://vanilla-breeze.com/docs/elements/custom-elements/site-legal/
- Vanilla Breeze 0.7.4

## Example

```html
<site-legal>
  <span>&copy; 2026 Acme Inc</span>
  <span>MIT License</span>
</site-legal>
```

## Attributes

| Attribute | Values | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `data-justify` | `start`, `center`, `end`, `between` | `center` | Row alignment (sets --site-legal-justify). start and between also clip the separator that would lead a wrapped row. |

## Structure

| Child | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `<span>` | Copyright or license text (author the year as text, e.g. <time datetime="2026">2026</time>) |
| `<a>` | Legal page link (privacy, terms); always underlined |
| `<ul> / <ol>` | List form: a single list whose <li> children are the items (list semantics and an item count) |

## CSS custom properties

| Property | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `--sep-list` | Separator text between items (default "\00B7", a middle dot); decorative, kept out of link names |
| `--site-legal-justify` | justify-content of the row (default center); start or space-between also clip the separator that would lead a wrapped row |

# <site-map>

Dual-mode sitemap: a lightweight static-sitemap enhancer (nav-enhance) or an interactive information-architecture tree with badges and an org-chart visual mode (ia-tree)

- Web component. Needs the Vanilla Breeze script; its children are the fallback when script has not run.
- Documentation: https://vanilla-breeze.com/docs/elements/web-components/site-map/
- Vanilla Breeze 0.7.4

## Example

```html
<site-map>
  <nav aria-label="Full site map">
    <ul>
      <li>
        <details>
          <summary><a href="/docs/">Documentation</a></summary>
          <ul>
            <li><a href="/docs/quick-start/">Quick Start</a></li>
            <li>
              <details>
                <summary><a href="/docs/elements/">Elements</a></summary>
                <ul>
                  <li><a href="/docs/elements/native/">Native</a></li>
                  <li><a href="/docs/elements/web-components/">Web Components</a></li>
                </ul>
              </details>
            </li>
          </ul>
        </details>
      </li>
      <li><a href="/about/">About</a></li>
      <li><a href="/blog/">Blog</a></li>
    </ul>
  </nav>
</site-map>
```

## Attributes

| Attribute | Values | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `mode` | `nav-enhance`, `ia-tree` | `nav-enhance` | Behavior mode: nav-enhance (static sitemap enhancer) or ia-tree (interactive IA tree) |
| `current` | string |  | [nav-enhance] Pathname of the current page |
| `src` | string |  | URL to JSON data (nav-enhance: { children: [{ title, href, children }] }, ia-tree: { title, pages }). Strings render as text; only http(s), relative and fragment hrefs become links. |
| `data-label-expand` | string | `Expand all` | [nav-enhance] Text of the expand-all button |
| `data-label-collapse` | string | `Collapse all` | [nav-enhance] Text of the collapse-all button |
| `data-label-controls` | string | `Sitemap controls` | [nav-enhance] Accessible name of the controls landmark |
| `title` | string |  | [ia-tree] Site map heading and tree name. Changing it rebuilds the tree. |
| `collapsed` | boolean |  | [ia-tree] Start all nodes collapsed. Changing it rebuilds the tree. |
| `compact` | boolean |  | [ia-tree] Reduced spacing variant (CSS only) |
| `data-view` | `visual` |  | [ia-tree] Set to "visual" for the SVG org-chart visualization. Changing it rebuilds. |
| `data-orientation` | `vertical`, `horizontal` | `vertical` | [ia-tree visual] Layout orientation. The toolbar flips it; setting it re-renders the chart. |
| `data-detail` | `0`, `1`, `2`, `3`, `4` | `2` | [ia-tree visual] Node detail: 0 shape, 1 title, 2 full, 3 full + status, 4 wireframe. The toolbar slider sets it; setting it re-renders the chart. |

## Attributes on children

| Attribute | On | Values | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `data-page-type` | li | string |  | [ia-tree] Page type: layout \| section \| dashboard \| page \| modal \| redirect |
| `data-template` | li | string |  | [ia-tree] Template or view name shown as a badge |
| `data-status` | li | string |  | [ia-tree] Page status: draft \| ready \| live \| deprecated |
| `data-sitemap` | nav | boolean |  | [nav-enhance] Marks a sitemap nav for the outline styling outside a <site-map> (inside one, the child nav is styled without it) |
| `data-sitemap-section` | li | boolean |  | [nav-enhance] A top-level item that is a headed block: an <h2> followed by a <ul> of groups laid out side by side |
| `data-sitemap-leaves` | ul | boolean |  | [nav-enhance] A long run of leaf pages that flows into columns |
| `data-sitemap-label` | span | boolean |  | [nav-enhance] Label of a branch that has no page of its own |
| `data-sitemap-updated` | small | boolean |  | [nav-enhance] A muted note of when a page, branch or section last changed |

## Structure

| Child | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `<nav>` | The sitemap: nested <ul>/<li><a> (ia-tree) or <details>/<summary> sections (nav-enhance) |

## Events

| Event | Detail | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `site-map:ready` | `{ nodeCount, depth }` | [ia-tree] Fired after the tree (or visual chart) is built |
| `site-map:select` | `{ href, pageType, template }` | [ia-tree] A node or its link was clicked |
| `site-map:pages-changed` | `{ pages, source: 'property' }` | [ia-tree] Fired after assigning the pages property rebuilds the tree |

## Properties

| Property | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `pages` | `Array<{ label, href?, pageType?, template?, status?, children? }>` | [ia-tree] Get the page tree as data, or assign one to rebuild (collapse state resets) |

## Accessibility

- Pattern: Native details/summary (default mode); Tree view (ia-tree mode)
- You provide: A <nav> with an aria-label wrapping nested lists of links, grouped with <details> in the default mode
- The component manages: `role="tree"`, `role="treeitem"`, `role="group"`, `aria-expanded`, `aria-current`, `aria-label`, `aria-hidden`, `aria-activedescendant`, `aria-selected`, `aria-level`, `aria-setsize`, `aria-posinset`, `aria-valuetext`, `tabindex roving`, `hidden`

## Keyboard

| Keys | Action | When |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `Enter` / `Space` | Open or close a group | Native behaviour of summary (default mode) |
| `ArrowDown` | Move to the next visible node | ia-tree mode, focus on a tree item |
| `ArrowUp` | Move to the previous visible node | ia-tree mode, focus on a tree item |
| `ArrowRight` | Expand a collapsed node, or move to the first child of an expanded node (reversed in right-to-left) | ia-tree mode, focus on a tree item |
| `ArrowLeft` | Collapse an expanded node, or move to the parent node (reversed in right-to-left) | ia-tree mode, focus on a tree item |
| `Enter` | Follow the node's link, or toggle a node that has no link | ia-tree mode, focus on a tree item |
| `Space` | Toggle a node that has children, or follow the link of a leaf node | ia-tree mode, focus on a tree item |
| `Home` | Move to the first node | ia-tree mode, focus on a tree item |
| `End` | Move to the last visible node | ia-tree mode, focus on a tree item |
| `ArrowDown` | Move to the first child of the active node | ia-tree mode with data-view="visual", vertical orientation (default), focus on the diagram |
| `ArrowUp` | Move to the parent of the active node | ia-tree mode with data-view="visual", vertical orientation (default), focus on the diagram |
| `ArrowRight` | Move to the next sibling | ia-tree mode with data-view="visual", vertical orientation (default), focus on the diagram |
| `ArrowLeft` | Move to the previous sibling | ia-tree mode with data-view="visual", vertical orientation (default), focus on the diagram |
| `ArrowRight` | Move to the first child of the active node | ia-tree mode with data-view="visual" and data-orientation="horizontal", focus on the diagram |
| `ArrowLeft` | Move to the parent of the active node | ia-tree mode with data-view="visual" and data-orientation="horizontal", focus on the diagram |
| `ArrowDown` | Move to the next sibling | ia-tree mode with data-view="visual" and data-orientation="horizontal", focus on the diagram |
| `ArrowUp` | Move to the previous sibling | ia-tree mode with data-view="visual" and data-orientation="horizontal", focus on the diagram |
| `Enter` | Follow the active node's link, or expand or collapse a node that has no link | ia-tree mode with data-view="visual", focus on the diagram |
| `Space` | Expand or collapse the active node | ia-tree mode with data-view="visual", focus on the diagram |
| `Home` | Move to the root node | ia-tree mode with data-view="visual", focus on the diagram |
| `End` | Move to the last visible node | ia-tree mode with data-view="visual", focus on the diagram |

# <site-search>

Pagefind-powered site search in a native modal <dialog>: combobox input, listbox of results, live result count

- Web component. Needs the Vanilla Breeze script; its children are the fallback when script has not run.
- Documentation: https://vanilla-breeze.com/docs/elements/web-components/site-search/
- Vanilla Breeze 0.7.4

## Example

```html
<site-search>
  <button data-trigger>
    <icon-wc name="search"></icon-wc>
    Search
  </button>
</site-search>
```

## Attributes

| Attribute | Values | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `open` | boolean |  | Reflected state — set by open()/close() methods, not intended as initial markup |
| `data-pagefind-path` | string | `/pagefind/` | Directory that holds pagefind.js, resolved against the document base. Set it for subpath deploys (e.g. /my-site/pagefind/). |
| `data-base-url` | string |  | Pagefind baseUrl prefixed to result URLs. Default: the directory above data-pagefind-path ("/" for the default path). |
| `data-label-trigger` | string | `Search` | Accessible name of the generated icon trigger (only when no trigger button is authored) |
| `data-label-dialog` | string | `Site search` | Accessible name of the search dialog |
| `data-label-placeholder` | string | `Search documentation...` | Input placeholder |
| `data-label-input` | string | `Search` | Accessible name of the search input |
| `data-label-results` | string | `Search results` | Accessible name of the results listbox |
| `data-label-searching` | string | `Searching...` | Status text while a search runs |
| `data-label-empty` | string | `No results found` | Status text when a query matches nothing |
| `data-label-count` | string | `{count} results` | Status text for several results ({count} is replaced) |
| `data-label-count-one` | string | `1 result` | Status text for exactly one result |
| `data-label-count-more` | string | `{count} of {total} results` | Status text when the index matched more results than the list shows ({count} listed, {total} matched) |
| `data-label-unavailable` | string | `Search unavailable` | Status text when the Pagefind index cannot be loaded (the developer hint goes to the console) |
| `data-label-error` | string | `Search error. Please try again.` | Status text when a search throws |
| `data-label-untitled` | string | `Untitled` | Title shown for a result without meta.title |
| `data-label-navigate` | string | `to navigate` | Footer hint after the arrow keys |
| `data-label-select` | string | `to select` | Footer hint after Enter |
| `data-label-close` | string | `to close` | Footer hint after Esc |
| `data-label-dismiss` | string | `Close search` | Accessible name of the close button beside the input (the Esc key cap; an × on narrow screens) |
| `data-label-browse` | string | `Browse instead` | Heading and accessible name of the browse links when the authored <nav data-browse> has no aria-label |
| `data-label-powered` | string | `Powered by` | Footer credit prefix |

## Attributes on children

| Attribute | On | Values | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `data-trigger` | button | boolean |  | Marks the button that opens the search dialog. Falls back to first <button> if absent. |

## Structure

| Child | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `<button data-trigger>` | Button that opens the search dialog (generated with a search icon when absent) |
| `<nav data-browse>` | Optional author-supplied links to other ways into the content (an index, a glossary, a sitemap). Shown in the dialog while there are no results; never shown in the page. Its aria-label, if set, is the heading. |

## Events

| Event | Detail | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `site-search:open` |  | Fired when the search dialog opens |
| `site-search:close` |  | Fired when the search dialog closes (Escape, backdrop click, close(), or choosing a result) |
| `site-search:change` | `{ value, source: 'api' }` | Fired when the value property sets a new query |

## Methods

| Method | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `open()` | Open the dialog with showModal() and focus the input |
| `close()` | Close the dialog, clear the query and results, and return focus to the trigger |

## Properties

| Property | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `isOpen` | `boolean` | Read-only: whether the dialog is open |
| `value` | `string` | The current query. Setting it runs the same debounced search as typing and fires site-search:change |
| `results` | `Array<PagefindResultData>` | Read-only copy of the current Pagefind result records (url, meta, excerpt) |

## Custom states

| State | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `:state(input-debounce-pending)` | A keystroke is waiting out the 150ms debounce before searching |

## Accessibility

- Pattern: Combobox in a native dialog
- You provide: Optionally a trigger button with an accessible name; a labelled search button is generated when none is authored
- The component manages: `role="combobox"`, `role="listbox"`, `role="option"`, `role="status"`, `aria-haspopup`, `aria-expanded`, `aria-controls`, `aria-autocomplete`, `aria-activedescendant`, `aria-selected`, `aria-label`, `aria-hidden`, `tabindex`

## Keyboard

| Keys | Action | When |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `Ctrl+k` / `Meta+k` | Open or close the search dialog | Focus anywhere on the page, including form fields |
| `ArrowDown` | Make the next result active, wrapping to the first | Focus in the search input |
| `ArrowUp` | Make the previous result active, wrapping to the last | Focus in the search input |
| `Enter` | Go to the active result, or to the first result when none is active | Focus in the search input |
| `Escape` | Close the dialog and return focus to the trigger | Focus in the search input |

Site-wide utility container for header and footer actions like search, theme picker, and settings

```html
  <nav class="horizontal pills" aria-label="Main navigation">
    <ul>
      <li><a href="/about">About</a></li>
      <li><a href="/docs">Docs</a></li>
    </ul>
  </nav>
  <site-tools>
    <site-search>
      <button type="button" data-trigger class="ghost">Search</button>
    </site-search>
    <theme-picker>
      <button type="button" data-trigger class="ghost">Theme</button>
    </theme-picker>

</header>
```
